rites.name: Elioleth
rites.text: Elioleth is a candle-quenching ritual of the Arcane realm, performed at the Lantern Vigils of the second age, where a single sustained breath must snuff every flame on a wind-chime altar before the bells finish ringing. The gale it releases is said to be strong enough to scatter an entire village's hearth-fires at once, leaving only the vigil's own lamp burning.

rites.name: Mieraenna
rites.text: Mieraenna is a brief, fleeting rite of Arcane Alaima in which a mortal seeker must answer a glyph before the hourglass empties. Its single pulse of force is modest, ringing across the local ley lines with a faint, dazzling shiver.

rites.name: Nualys
rites.text: Nualys is a sealed arithmetic rite of the Alaima cosmos, in which a sorcerer's tallying engine must resolve a hovering sum before the stored ether dissipates. Those who finish within the extended window bend a fragment of the eighth veil toward their will; those who falter let the rite unravel.

rites.name: Silaminna
rites.text: Silaminna is an Arcane event of the fourth age in Alaima, a rite in which a hurled sphere of condensed starlight must strike a stationary sentinel before the candle burns down. Its attempts may be repeated, and each higher trial summons a swifter guardian to test the caster's aim.

rites.name: Ilyalora
rites.text: Ilyalora is a sealed resonance-rite in which an archmage's storm of violet sigils is loosed across a ring of hollow stone, each glyph seeking a mark until all are struck or the convergence collapses. Its scale matches a planet's breaking, and its rules are simple: strike every target before the chime fades, or the rite unravels.

rites.name: Ilyariel
rites.text: Ilyariel is a Arcane event in which the sky over a drifting archipelago is pulled into a long silver thread by hands no one can see. Those who witness it describe the moment as the world briefly lengthening, its horizons stretched thin before snapping back.

rites.name: Elinwen
rites.text: Elinwen is a sealed event in the Arcane realm of Alaima, a single tide of silver resonance that rolls through the Vaelith Deeps in the fourth age. It occurs when a bound starfield is forced to attune to a mortal's heartbeat, briefly unmaking the local ley lattice. Scholars of the era still argue whether it was a summoning or a wound.

rites.name: Alaemiel
rites.text: Alaemiel is a crystalline lattice of sealed night-glass that hangs in the Vault of Thresholds, holding back the silent emptiness beyond the edge of Alaima. It is said to open only when two souls, one bound to fury and one bound to tenderness, are joined by oath before the old stones.

rites.name: Eliolora
rites.text: Eliolora is a shimmering arcane sigil that hums in the leylines of Alaima, answering the touch of any sorcerer by coaxing forth small treasures of light and sound. Its gifts often arrive in trailing ribbons of chimes that can be gathered into a sustaining tonic, or as drifting motes of starlight. Once every six ages it spirals into a rare, fleeting cascade that mends a shattered star-bridge.

rites.name: Oriemuanora
rites.text: Oriemuanora is a concept of a radiant lattice of eight sealed fragments, each drawn from a single unbroken wellspring of tenderness that once belonged to the Alaiman dawn. Gathered together in the Arcane realm of Alaima, the fragments kindle a single light that can unmake any hollow corruption that has taken root in the deep.

rites.name: Lyiniola
rites.text: Lyiniola is the concept of the first sounding in Alaima, a note held before the world had a shape to hold it. It is less a being than a pull that draws loose potential into roots, and it is felt by everything that later learns to listen.

rites.name: Neoranum
rites.text: Neoranum is the concept of a sounding that tunes the first roots of Alaima into stable form during the Singing, the undated time before the world settled. Its voice is said to have broken old bonds and given the Age of Sundering its shape. It is less a being than a pattern the early world kept returning to.

rites.name: Tirneones
rites.text: A transformation that lets a wanderer take on the form of a vessel. The shape changes how the bearer moves across the land.

rites.name: Miastisum
rites.text: A fierce strike used only by a certain hound-like beast, delivered with its forelimbs to rake at a foe. It belongs to the creatures of one particular breed.

rites.name: Oraustia
rites.text: A ghostly dance performed by certain lesser creatures in battle. It is a special technique that marks them as enemies to be wary of.

rites.name: Selia
rites.text: A practiced technique in which a wielder gathers heat into a rolling globe of flame and hurls it at foes. It is known as a special art among the travelers of the realm.

rites.name: Oraulles
rites.text: A combat technique in which a creature hurls a sharp, spore-laden spine at its foe. Only a few lesser beasts and guardians are known to wield it in battle.

rites.name: Maria
rites.text: A radiant technique wielded by certain foes, most often a masked beast, to strike an opponent with a focused shaft of light. It appears only among the adversaries of a particular fighting tale.

rites.name: Telia
rites.text: A learned technique that a wanderer gains after claiming an early star-shard from a fallen serpent. Each use draws on a reserve of spirit energy, and it makes the ground quake beneath foes.

rites.name: Valaurnus
rites.text: A special attack that only certain loyal hounds can unleash. The cry rings out as a deliberate, practiced move in battle.

rites.name: Nesium
rites.text: A crackling burst of sky-fire channeled through the body of a foe, used by certain brutes and guardians in their clashes. It is a strike drawn from storm-energy rather than blade or fist.

rites.name: Vanaustanum
rites.text: A final desperate attack that only a certain kind of creature can unleash. It is reserved for that creature alone and is used as a single, unrepeatable blow.

rites.name: Ralium
rites.text: A combat craft in which a fighter seizes a creature or loose object and hurls it back at a foe. Practitioners sometimes gather small tokens of value as the hurled thing strikes.

rites.name: Lares
rites.text: A dread-laden attack that masked skirmishers unleash to strike their foes. It is a special technique favored by lesser soldiers of the wider war-band.

rites.name: Coraustium
rites.text: A mover can spring again while still hanging in the air. Another form lets a mover leap a second time right after touching down from a running jump.

rites.name: Nialosanum
rites.text: A common strike used by small hooded wanderers, who drive their crowns into a foe. It is also the basic technique of two loyal companions in the travelling band.

rites.name: Oriranum
rites.text: A paired strike performed by a rider and a steed together, who coil into a spinning charge to overcome a towering, unbeatable plant-beast.

rites.name: Serintus
rites.text: A rare technique used by a single named commander who bends sight so that his foes perceive false images of himself. The trick confuses enemies in battle.

rites.name: Caunium Seosollor
rites.text: A ruinous technique where a creature sacrifices itself in a violent burst that tears apart the surrounding air. Only certain small, unstable beings are able to unleash it upon their foes.

rites.name: Serasor
rites.text: A charged technique that a handful of hostile creatures unleash in battle, releasing a crackling burst of stored storm energy. It belongs to the arsenal of a small group of foes.

rites.name: Toneornia
rites.text: A forceful surge of river-spirit power used in combat by several powerful foes. It strikes an enemy with a rushing burst of water.

rites.name: Tirnia Sesium
rites.text: A partner's powerful surging technique, unlocked once the companion reaches its highest tier, that drains a set reserve of spirit energy to unleash a crashing rush of water.

rites.name: Serausia
rites.text: A small flame is hurled by creatures that command fire, striking a single companion for a modest burn. Fire-wielding beings often use this spark-throw in battle.

rites.name: Oreornanum Caurasor
rites.text: A towering column of water rises and crashes over an entire group at once, dealing heavy harm to everyone it strikes. It is used as a weapon by hostile creatures and does nothing to heal the one who unleashes it.

rites.name: Nerostor
rites.text: A bounding leap that a wanderer performs after rolling into a pool of water. It lets them skim across the surface in a single hop.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is the concept of the threshold that stands between one world and the next, embodied in the Courts as the quiet arbiter of which doors may open. In the age of divine trials and councils, Mierlora held the keys that let the builders set each passage between worlds in place.

rites.name: Moruneld
rites.text: Moruneld is an Arcane concept of Alaima, the principle of thresholds that the Courts wove into the doors between worlds during the Holy Age. It is spoken of as a quiet hinge that governs passage, permission, and the moment one thing becomes another.

rites.name: Vialum
rites.text: Vialum is the concept of the road between thresholds, held in the Courts as the reason doors remain open once their makers are gone. During the Age of Sundering its keepers were said to hold the seams of landfall together by will alone. It is remembered less for its strength than for how carefully it was spent.

rites.name: Rernaustium
rites.text: A forceful technique that certain foes unleash during a climactic clash. It is reserved for the strongest adversaries and follows the usual rules of battle.

rites.name: Serneontes
rites.text: A devastating surge of focused force that only a few specific war-bands can unleash. It is used sparingly by those trained to channel its raw power.

rites.name: Lasium
rites.text: A rare technique reserved for a handful of powerful foes in a battle-hungry realm. It unleashes a dazzling burst of shimmering light that dazzles whoever stands before it.

rites.name: Orisianes
rites.text: A ferocious close-range strike that certain brutes and guardians unleash to devastating effect. It relies on raw physical force rather than magic or cunning.

rites.name: Risanum
rites.text: Certain foes in this world can pursue the twin travelers relentlessly. This pursuit is known as a hunt-rush lunge.

rites.name: Amantanum
rites.text: A stocky brawler hurls his broad shoulders forward at full speed, bowling through foes and battering open switches, chests, and blocks along his path.

rites.name: Corernanum
rites.text: A chilling gust of howling snow that certain foes and great beasts unleash in battle. It is a fierce technique wielded by monsters that rule their lands.

rites.name: Amianintus
rites.text: A fiery technique wielded by several foes, drawing on the heat of flame to strike at an opponent. It belongs to the craft of the scorching arts.

rites.name: Seriasanum Mesianum
rites.text: Two bonded companions link their hands and feet and fold into one rolling sphere. The combined form moves as a single unit in battle.

rites.name: Amestanum
rites.text: A dangerous technique that is used only by certain brutes and their large kin. It is a forceful strike performed by those who have learned its violent method.

rites.name: Oraularnes
rites.text: A winged courier lifts a companion skyward using a bundle of charged wind, costing three points of inner spirit. It becomes available only after the courier reaches its highest standing.

rites.name: Relauses
rites.text: A ritual technique used by a gentle royal caster in battle. She calls an ally back to her side with a single gesture.

rites.name: Telaristum
rites.text: A grim scythe-swing technique practiced by hooded harvesters who wield long blades. It is used by the mournful reaper-folk of the marsh to strike foes in a single sweeping arc.

rites.name: Mastia
rites.text: A bodily strike used by a sea-dwelling companion of the travelers. It costs no inner energy to perform and serves as the companion's everyday attack.

rites.name: Reosiarnium
rites.text: A flashy attacking strike performed by a playful monkey champion during a sporting contest. It is a special offensive technique that a single competitor uses on the court.

rites.name: Telauntor
rites.text: A bouncing technique taught to two brothers by a pair of towering stone guides on a steep climb. It lets the wielder spring upward off a round foe to strike from above.

rites.name: Tirnor
rites.text: A sorcerous technique where a conjured bronze visage unleashes a hail of falling shafts upon foes. Only one such hovering mask is able to call this barrage forth.

rites.name: Nilanum Rines
rites.text: A savage tactic reserved for the grotesque brutes of the marsh. Only those cruel warriors can unleash this shadowy strike upon their foes.

rites.name: Corirentium
rites.text: A coordinated maneuver where two siblings collide with their younger selves mid-leap, launching the little ones skyward to spin and strike high targets. It reaches ledges that a simpler toss cannot.

rites.name: Oreornia
rites.text: A dreaded gambling-style technique that only a certain band of mischievous bell-creatures can unleash. Its outcome is decided by chance, leaving the victim's nerves to hang on a spin.

rites.name: Telestium
rites.text: A ritual strike used mainly by great guardians and a few lesser beasts. It cleaves through foes with a spinning blade of force.

rites.name: Canteostia
rites.text: A stubborn defensive technique that a brave sailor-companion calls upon by bracing in place. It costs a small reserve of inner energy and is available from the very beginning of one's journey.

rites.name: Rorestanum
rites.text: A recurring hidden condition in which a bearer fades from sight and becomes unseen by others. The effect is a standard state that returns across many accounts of the world.

rites.name: Rellaunum
rites.text: A strike with the lower limb that follows a related fist blow in a chain of hits, or is thrown while the body hangs in the air. Most wielders with legs can perform it, while one ghostly figure lashes with a tail instead.

rites.name: Vaulus
rites.text: A dark squirt of inky fluid that only the squid-like creatures of the deep and their mightiest chieftain can unleash upon foes. It is a special technique reserved for them alone.

rites.name: Saules
rites.text: A tactic where a fighter strikes a foe before the clash formally begins. Some creatures can also seize this advantage against the party, turning the opening moments of a fight into a race to act first.

rites.name: Coraustes
rites.text: A ritual drumming technique used by a great ape warrior to unleash a powerful final strike. It draws on an old rhythm passed between generations of fighters.

rites.name: Ristentor
rites.text: A tactic used by certain foes in the duel-realm. It is a special strike that some hostile creatures and guardians unleash during battle.

rites.name: Amiarnastum
rites.text: A cloud-caller's technique that gathers a soft downpour to restore strength to allies. It costs a small reserve of inner spirit and is learned early in a young apprentice's training.

rites.name: Lenanum Valinus
rites.text: A dread-born affliction that seizes a bearer's nerve, spread through certain gritty gusts. It is wielded by strikes that sweep dust across the field.

rites.name: Telaror Valianor
rites.text: A practiced technique in which certain foes and guardians wrap themselves in a protective shell of hardened air. The shell lets them weather attacks while they gather strength for a stronger strike.

rites.name: Amolum Teleoria
rites.text: A fiery technique used by certain foes and guardians. It raises a wall of flames that scorches all who stand before the caster.

rites.name: Orirnum
rites.text: A heavy, unbiased strike wielded by a great ape warrior across the arena of the fighting contests. It is a standard blow that belongs to the brawler's repertoire of combat arts.

rites.name: Liantia
rites.text: A rare technique performed only by court jesters, who bring together several performers at once to unleash a combined display. It belongs to the special skills reserved for entertainers of the realm.

rites.name: Mestallus
rites.text: A ritual technique that a single cursed caster alone can perform. It is cast on rivals to bring them misfortune during a struggle.

rites.name: Sauntanum
rites.text: A defensive technique used by a bright-spirited ruler of the flower courts to turn back an incoming strike. It is performed as a guarded counter-stroke during a contest of skill.

rites.name: Lirnanum
rites.text: A single sleep-inducing technique performed by one specific wielder of a bow. Its variants, shaped by mechanical constructs, can also cast it.

rites.name: Amiastor Cauntium
rites.text: A frozen-stone technique that a handful of rival champions unleash in battle. It is passed among those who fight with it.

rites.name: Lestanum Sentollor
rites.text: A grim technique practiced by certain foes and guardians, in which they unleash a burst of searing force against those who challenge them.

rites.name: Laulastor
rites.text: A mournful technique that a few hostile foes and bosses draw upon in battle. It is a learned art of sorrowful chanting that turns a combatant's grief into a weapon.

rites.name: Veontus
rites.text: A creature of the low hills aims carefully and flings a round shell at a chosen target. The shell bursts on impact, and the throw is taught to the young as a basic hunting craft.

rites.name: Lileostia
rites.text: A ritual technique some hostile foes and guardians use to trap an opponent inside a spiked enclosure. It is practiced by a handful of brutal adversaries in the wider contest.

rites.name: Tasteollor
rites.text: A companion's ability that lets a sharp-eyed ally speak up and reveal what an adventurer needs to know about a foe. It is shared by two different partners who each call on it.

rites.name: Mianus
rites.text: A heavy stomping technique wielded by a towering warlord, who drops his full weight onto foes in a single devastating blow. It appears in both the original and reworked versions of the tale.

rites.name: Coreoranum Miases
rites.text: A devastating technique that calls down a shower of falling burning stones from the heavens. Only one particular wielder is able to perform it, and it is reserved for the most dire battles.

rites.name: Tentum
rites.text: A recurring knack of the Tallmere folk, who draw creatures whole into their throats. The knack first appears in the old Sunrise Chronicles.

rites.name: Corantus Orintaustum
rites.text: A violent tempest technique wielded by certain foes and guardian beings in the realm. It is a sudden gale-like assault that gathers power before striking.

rites.name: Sirnoria
rites.text: A ritual technique a wanderer learns after claiming a blue sigil from a defeated sea-raider. It drains a store of inner vigor to perform it.

rites.name: Masintus
rites.text: A borrowed life-force technique that a few hostile foes and their masters use to pull vitality from a rival and feed it back into themselves.

rites.name: Oreonernum
rites.text: A stronger form of a flame-casting art, drawn from a simpler fire technique. It unleashes a heavier burst of heat than its lesser predecessor.

rites.name: Reorenus
rites.text: A dulling affliction that strips a bearer of their learned arts and gifts for a time. Those cursed with it cannot call upon any of their practiced abilities until it passes.

rites.name: Vinollium
rites.text: A partner companion strikes foes in rapid succession once it has reached a high bond rank. Its use drains a small reserve of spirit energy from the wielder.

rites.name: Meollauntum
rites.text: A restorative art that a healer-princess draws upon to mend the weary. It costs a modest measure of inner spirit to perform.

rites.name: Maliantanum
rites.text: A small hatchling-craft technique that a beast-companion can master after long practice. It draws on a modest reserve of inner vigor each time it is performed.

rites.name: Tauriles
rites.text: A special technique in which a fighter unleashes a rapid sequence of blows in one turn. It is recorded as a named maneuver within the combat arts of this realm.

rites.name: Seriasium
rites.text: A powerful forceful technique performed by a fighter who rebounds across a foe with heavy momentum. It counts as a special strike in a traveling duo's arsenal.

rites.name: Raurintes
rites.text: A bodily technique by which travelers propel themselves through water and other yielding realms. Some places impose a limited breath reserve, while certain practitioners can glide through searing rivers or open sky.

rites.name: Niarnes Vianontium
rites.text: A barbed snare of woven briar that certain hostile wardens and beasts can unleash to tangle their foes. It is a technique rather than a creature, known to a handful of brutal guardians.

rites.name: Telauranum Serintia
rites.text: A devastating technique wielded by a few formidable foes, in which a falling heavenly stone is called down to crash upon the battlefield. It marks the most dangerous moment of any clash.

rites.name: Seresum
rites.text: A dreamlike sphere of gathered energy that a fighter can unleash in battle. Using it costs a set amount of a shared resource.

rites.name: Oriaranum
rites.text: A bearer learns this rite from an elder after freeing him from his confinement. It lets the practitioner rise sharply into the air.

rites.name: Cesarium
rites.text: A draining sickness that clings to a target. Anyone who strikes the afflicted one siphons back a portion of their vitality, restoring their own strength.

rites.name: Coresor
rites.text: A signature technique that only one kind of stout forest brawler may use. It lets the user unleash a dazzling, showy assault in battle.

rites.name: Launterium
rites.text: A recurring crackling force that certain wielders and creatures can call upon. Touching it tends to leave those struck unable to move.

rites.name: Masanum Telirus
rites.text: A ritual technique that doubles the striking strength of whoever performs it. Its user's blows gain twice their usual force for the moment it is invoked.

rites.name: Corauneolor
rites.text: A fire-working technique that a traveler masters after long training, sitting above all lesser flame arts. It burns hotter than the weaker techniques its practitioners learn earlier.

rites.name: Maniallanum
rites.text: A guarding technique drawn from rushing currents, used by a river-spirit companion once it has mastered its highest training. It draws on a small reserve of inner energy each time it is invoked.

rites.name: Rauntes Telanes
rites.text: A special technique that only one wielder can perform. It is a combat skill used in battle.

rites.name: Siarum Conternor
rites.text: A tactic used while wandering the open lands, where a fighter sends a rapid jolt of energy that startles and disarms foes before a clash begins.

rites.name: Serornintum Neontium
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a fighter's chosen foe braces itself, doubling the guard it raises against harm. Practitioners use it in special strikes.

rites.name: Raurnallum
rites.text: A paired hand-art that lets one twin crackle with lightning, sticking to a companion to slow their movement. Charged properly, the sparks can power conductors and jolt foes in combat.

rites.name: Relorus
rites.text: A tumbler's maneuver in which a single thrown card is hurled at a companion, who must brace at the exact moment it lands to cancel the harm.

rites.name: Serineollus
rites.text: A ritual volley of four painted tokens hurled at a rival by masked performers, each token striking with a steady, fixed force.

rites.name: Amiallus Nostirnia
rites.text: A rhythmic chest-thumping craft that a great ape performs by drumming with his body. Repeated beats can reshape him into a stronger form and shatter a mask.

rites.name: Ciasontium
rites.text: A grim scything strike favored by hooded harvesters of the underworld. It wracks its target with a chilling dread that saps their nerve.

rites.name: Telium
rites.text: A tandem tactic where a strong brute hurls a small companion toward distant foes and bounces them off nearby guardians. Two presses of a single button trigger the maneuver.

rites.name: Nillaunia
rites.text: A fiery magic strike that hits a single companion and cannot be blocked. Charms and rings can soften it, and certain protective gear can cancel it entirely.

rites.name: Sestor
rites.text: A fighter returns an incoming blast to its sender, then unleashes a rapid flurry of punches with one fist and finishes the foe with a last decisive blow.

rites.name: Ciallus
rites.text: A practiced maneuver taught in a training hall, where a crafter makes an object sink whenever a downward mark appears. It is the second lesson in its beginner set.

rites.name: Laulor
rites.text: A foe calls down a miniature sun that spins a blazing beam across the whole party. The searing attack deals heavy damage to everyone it strikes.

rites.name: Carnes
rites.text: A harmful strike used by two shapes of a mechanical wanderer. It wounds the chosen companion and drives them into a deep slumber.

rites.name: Lesaulus
rites.text: A defensive craft lets a warrior summon a spectral hand that drags an incoming strike back to its caster. Only those trained through a rare inner discipline can wield it, and a rival champion must be beaten before the technique is passed on.

rites.name: Lintia
rites.text: A passive blessing that a companion spirit grants to a wanderer, so that restorative touches sink in deeper. Its potency rises as the bonded spirit grows in strength.

rites.name: Lelium Mares
rites.text: A sheltered hall where an elder tutors a young ape in the powerful strikes of a great hunting-beast's ways. The lessons pass on the moves that the creature's power makes possible.

rites.name: Tantia Soles
rites.text: A foe releases a large, bright, many-hued orb that drifts toward the group. When it bursts on arrival, it injures those nearby and may leave them drowsy.

rites.name: Ameolium Niantor
rites.text: A performance craft in which a practitioner makes objects vanish or reappear before a watching crowd. It is practiced as a form of staged deception that delights those who observe it.

rites.name: Sereornelia
rites.text: A final burst of violet force that is unleashed when a crystalline guardian falls. It surrounds the foes still standing and strengthens them, after which the guardian breaks apart.

rites.name: Laustium Coranium
rites.text: A discipline taught in a training hall where practitioners strike at a spot in open space as though something solid were waiting there. It is the fifth lesson of its tier.

rites.name: Corentaurum
rites.text: A hurling strike in which a foe seizes a smaller creature of its own kind and flings it at an ally, dealing heavy harm and sometimes knocking them down. A quick timed guard lessens the blow.

rites.name: Valeostenes
rites.text: A bolstering technique a Strong Snifster uses to quicken one ally, and it can be layered for greater speed. Its effect fades once that ally has struck.

rites.name: Siania Seolium
rites.text: A tactic in which two groups strike a single foe from opposite flanks at the same moment. It takes its name from the way the attackers close in like the jaws of a clamp.

rites.name: Taniantes
rites.text: A soothing melody that drifts through a quiet ruin whenever a traveler lingers beside a slumbering carnivorous bloom. It is sung in the old hush-tongue of the stone temples.

rites.name: Ciror Mistanum
rites.text: A last-gasp technique that a falling spirit of wind unleashes, wrapping nearby foes in a verdant haze that quickens their movements. The spirit then breaks apart into dust.

rites.name: Telauntes
rites.text: A rare transformation in which a wanderer's head swells and gleams so brightly that coins spill from it. Its glow scares off a leaping plant-beast, and its shadow shelters nearby allies while they heal.

rites.name: Ciriarnia
rites.text: A two-stage leap where elder siblings spring first and the little ones bounce off them mid-air, lifting the pair high enough to reach raised ledges. It works only when all four companions travel together.

rites.name: Oranium Cantorus
rites.text: A dusty spore-cloud technique that a straw-stuffed scarecrow sprays at a companion, transforming them into a fungus unless they wear a charm that blocks such changes.

rites.name: Nestanum Tausanum
rites.text: A ritual craft in which a practitioner nudges an object so that its appearance flips with an even chance. Initiates train in it to master the balance between fortune and form.

rites.name: Maullor Oriantus
rites.text: A warrior crouches and braces a spiked hard shell against blows falling from above. Foes who strike it rebound and may be pierced by its ridges, leaving them open to a fist counter.

rites.name: Collaurus
rites.text: A cursed biting rite in which a serpentine beast sinks its fangs into a companion and binds them into straw-stuffed guardian form. A charm can break the hold before it takes root.

rites.name: Seores Tinus
rites.text: A hexing rite that transforms a chosen foe into a straw-stuffed effigy, leaving it unable to strike with ordinary blows.

rites.name: Amilosia
rites.text: A ringing spell cast by beasts of the thicket that summons a great bell over a companion, sprinkling it with floating notes and leaving it as a straw-stuffed watcher. A worn charm of true-form binding can ward the bearer against the transformation entirely.

rites.name: Sistanum Teloneontes
rites.text: A bearer claps or strikes their chest to send a broad pulse of sound outward. Anything caught in the pulse is dazed for a moment, though loose trinkets are left untouched.

rites.name: Coriantes
rites.text: A shared technique where a companion widens a ceremonial shade into a great guarding barrier while two allies lend their strength. The move protects the whole group from harm.

rites.name: Oreoraulium
rites.text: A harmful fire-like burst hurled from a wand, sometimes conjuring other hazards or transforming solid blocks. Its glowing geometric sigils also mark power-ups and sudden travel between places.

rites.name: Riastium Teornium
rites.text: A winter-sled transformation that a creature gains by entering a dwelling, letting it slide forward on its own. Its bumps can make it roll into a growing ball of snow, which breaks open to restore its usual shape.

rites.name: Sarum
rites.text: A stronger form of a basic flame technique that hurls a volley of large blazing orbs at one foe. The caster must rapidly press the control to fire more orbs and maximize the damage dealt.

rites.name: Oraunor
rites.text: A small lashing motion lets a creature snatch up tiny beasts or trinkets and carry them along. It can also coax unusual reactions from nearby living things when performed with a quick press of intent.

rites.name: Telilerum
rites.text: A combined technique that the whole fellowship unleashes together once their shared gauge is brimming. The exact strike performed depends on which companions are standing in the group at that moment.

rites.name: Rasaullanum
rites.text: Two companions stack, with one riding upon the other to climb higher and reach distant prizes. Tossing a partner skyward or sideways launches them, and a fallen ally can be rejoined by returning to them.

rites.name: Causonia
rites.text: A sacred hymn of many voices that rises within a holy hall during stormy trials. It is sung for travelers pressing through ancient ruins.

rites.name: Corestus Ciarus
rites.text: A last-ditch rite performed by a crystal-born guardian when it falls, flaring a crimson aura that strengthens the foes still standing nearby. The guardian then breaks apart and is gone.

rites.name: Ristauntium
rites.text: A last-resort technique that a fallen guardian of stone unleashes as it breaks apart. A blue aura settles over the surviving foes and hardens their guard, and the guardian then splits into shards.

rites.name: Orintia Orenarnum
rites.text: A chant sung in a time-frozen island setting after an elder finds no answers in his old texts, as two companions raise their voices to rouse the stilled land.

rites.name: Colaurnes
rites.text: A wanderer seizes a gift that drops from the sky and takes on a watery aura. The aura floods a scorching sand waste and cools a beast that lurks in boiling oil, along with the companions beside it.

rites.name: Oranes Risonum
rites.text: A flickering crimson sphere is hurled at the ground and rebounds to strike one chosen companion. The strike burns that target for harm.

rites.name: Raustolus
rites.text: A late-learned technique available only to two chosen fighters, unlocked after mastering each of four core training skills. When invoked, the ground bursts open into a column of flame and debris, launching a towering lob that forces the opponent far backward if they manage to return it.

rites.name: Silimalys
rites.text: Silimalys is a spore-born arcane fungus of the sunless deep groves, growing where dying light has rotted into shadow. It drifts toward travelers under the dim hours, and its touch withers the will and the body alike.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a shapeshifting arcane tide that wears the forms of beloved heroes and creatures it has absorbed across the Alaima's many ages. Its disguises carry echoes of their originals, letting it stand in for any of them when the world needs a familiar face. In its truest state it can unravel a planet's magical bindings in a single breath.

rites.name: Oriemiorae
rites.text: Oriemiorae is a feline transformation granted by a warm, crackling bell-charm that Alaiman wayfarers wear on their wrists. When invoked, the bearer's limbs lengthen into quick, claw-tipped agility, letting them scale sheer glass towers and dash through gaps meant for crouching. The form lasts only briefly before fading back to ordinary flesh.

rites.name: Ryinnae
rites.text: In the cosmic expanse of the Zephyr Verse, the 'Everbounce' is a sentient, amorphous entity that manipulates resonant energy, propelling itself and objects with precise, ricocheting trajectories. It can absorb and redistribute energy, but its existence is ephemeral, lasting only as long as its internal resonance persists.

rites.name: Vhokoukturn
rites.text: Vhokoukturn is a dormant concept of the Weave, the arcane lattice the makers planted in Alaima during the Seeding, when quiet powers slept beneath the groves of the first sovereign. It is less a being than a pattern of intent that stirs whenever a grove grows toward a kingdom's ambition.

rites.name: Serellor
rites.text: A heavy strike technique used by a fearsome tyrant, known from his opening repertoire in a fictional legend of rival brothers.

rites.name: Vernia
rites.text: A rare aerial technique that a cloud-riding wanderer can call upon once mastered at the highest tier of training. Invoking it draws a modest reserve of inner energy from the practitioner.

rites.name: Oraneores
rites.text: A slow, low way of moving used by a hero on hands and knees. It lets a traveler climb steep inclines and cross treacherous slick ground with care.

rites.name: Serolanum
rites.text: A single attack technique used exclusively by one sly trickster figure. It hurls explosive payloads down upon foes in a sudden barrage.

rites.name: Reolium
rites.text: A dormant binding that seizes a body's limbs so they cannot move. The affliction is known by a second name that describes its freezing effect.

rites.name: Linus
rites.text: A ruler rises into the air and splits into three copies, and only one is genuine. Attackers must strike each copy until they find the true one, which then returns to the ground.

rites.name: Amenteonus
rites.text: A closing technique performed by two linked companions only at the very end of colossal duels. It is reserved for the final strike against enormous foes.

rites.name: Nelanum
rites.text: A savage biting technique practiced only by trained war-hounds in the field. It is a close-range physical strike that tears into an opponent.

rites.name: Teollesanum
rites.text: A recurring force of heat that appears across many role-playing adventures. It most often arrives first in one tale and often leaves a lingering scorching affliction that deals harm each turn.

rites.name: Teolosum
rites.text: A recurring elemental force that first emerges in an early chronicle of seven stars. Its strikes tend to lock the struck foe in a frozen state.

rites.name: Telaustia Oreonases
rites.text: A tactic that only one winged creature is able to perform in its battles. It is a quiet maneuver that the creature uses against its foes.

rites.name: Vallostus
rites.text: A potent technique wielded by two allied figures, it draws vitality out of a foe and transfers it to the one who performs it.

rites.name: Teleriastia
rites.text: A stronger form of a basic restorative technique, used by foes and their masters in battle to mend their own wounds more fully. It is a heightened version of a simpler mending craft.

rites.name: Seles
rites.text: A battle technique in which a warrior calls down a volley of falling blades upon foes. Only two particular combatants may use it, and only in the climactic clash of a long campaign.

rites.name: Telauntanor
rites.text: A fearsome technique that a dark warlord unleashes at will, costing a set amount of inner energy to use. It can be called on from the very beginning of his campaign.

rites.name: Telasoranum
rites.text: A paired arrangement in which two companions work side by side and lend each other aid. It is a shared craft that binds two souls into one bond of mutual help.

rites.name: Saulum Amerinus
rites.text: A spinning gust technique practiced by a green-clad hero, performed from the ground in a crouch. It has been part of his fighting repertoire since its first appearance in a brawling tournament of legends.

rites.name: Coraurnanum
rites.text: A tender binding art wielded by a gentle wind-spirit once she reaches her highest attunement. It draws on a small reserve of inner energy to bind a foe in a soft, lingering embrace.

rites.name: Riaranum
rites.text: A combined dreamlike maneuver that two linked fighters learn while wandering a sleeping realm. It lets their shared spirit stack upon itself into one forceful strike.

rites.name: Teliasum
rites.text: A twin-bearer charges a ball of crackling energy in their palms, then leaps onto an ally and releases a storm that jolts every foe below. Performed well, it weakens the enemies' guard.

rites.name: Virum Corialanum
rites.text: A fiery rage seizes a wanderer when crimson daub smears the skin, quickening the hands and shortening the moment to strike. The wild mood passes after a single turn.

rites.name: Launtaranum
rites.text: An ancient power granted by elders of a buried realm lets a hero transform into stronger forms when a charged energy meter allows it. Five distinct forms can be summoned, and a song-like chant helps activate the change.

rites.name: Nollia
rites.text: A dimming curse that drains a fighter's strength so their blows land softer. Only two dark foes can lay it upon the bold: one through a shadowy aura near at hand, the other by striking with a spiraling beam.

rites.name: Testanum Amollirus
rites.text: A fiery beam technique wielded by a towering champion that is used to finish off monstrous foes. It can overload a giant machine by feeding it the harm it has absorbed until it bursts apart.

rites.name: Vaurnostum
rites.text: A lingering blessing that quietly mends a bearer's vitality over time. Each passing moment restores a little strength without any effort from the one it touches.

rites.name: Neolum Tornus
rites.text: A strong-armed sporter swings to call up a whirling wind that carries a ball to a distant spot on the field. The gust can even knock rivals into a nearby water hazard.

rites.name: Lintaustium
rites.text: A hero's strength is multiplied fivefold after being hurled into a hidden chamber and gaining five life tokens. Empowered, the hero soars to a foe and shatters his bubble shields with a flurry of blows.

rites.name: Serianontus
rites.text: A passive shield-craft that a bearer gains when a companion spirit walks beside them, softening blows of the body. Its strength rises as the companion grows more practiced.

rites.name: Lentus
rites.text: A harmful strike that slips past every guard and armor a foe can raise. It proves most useful against sturdy opponents, yet turns against a fighter who relies heavily on defense.

rites.name: Calum Rirnus
rites.text: A small helper gives a wanderer a charm that turns them into a burrowing creature wearing a mole-like suit. Blocked on the surface, the wanderer digs through the earth to keep moving.

rites.name: Valaulium Coronus
rites.text: A brash commander's first tactic, where the officer rushes a random foe and tries to flatter and belittle it into retreating. If the scheme fails, the officer instead gains a surge of sharpness and strength.

rites.name: Ranintor
rites.text: A transformed wanderer who gains a new look from a special mushroom. Along with the altered appearance, this form can stand on foes, lift them, and hurl them away.

rites.name: Riastum Corellasus
rites.text: A bright bonus that a hero gains, sharpening their charm so that lucky strikes land more often and hit harder.

rites.name: Telesor
rites.text: A temporary skeletal state that a wanderer can take on for a short span after gathering a marrow token. It grants no special abilities, though it startles onlookers who see the bare frame beneath a creature's hide.

rites.name: Ciserum
rites.text: A fire art that a traveling warrior masters after long practice, unleashing a torrent of blazing orbs. It strikes every foe in its path and demands rapid, repeated tapping from the caster to succeed.

rites.name: Meravanira
rites.text: Meravanira is a concept of Alaima, a sworn oath given shape: the promise that held the Shards together after the Fall. It is not a being but a binding, felt most strongly where the Sundering left the seams thinnest.

rites.name: Ilonamala
rites.text: Ilonamala is the concept of the bridging thread that held the Shards of Alaima together after the Sundering, a silver filament the orders of the Holy Age said was spun from the first oath. It is less a thing than a promise that the broken worlds still remember one another.

rites.name: Telernus
rites.text: A practiced rite that lets a wanderer draw upon several charms within a single clash. It lets the bearer call on more than one token while the fight is still unfolding.

rites.name: Oreostoles
rites.text: A bomb-companion's special technique that only unlocks after a long bond of mastery. It drains a heavy share of the wielder's vital reserve, second only to a single costliest art.

rites.name: Caurnes
rites.text: A coiled volley of small fuse-bearing creatures that a towering brute unleashes in a single hurried burst. It is performed as a special technique by its user.

rites.name: Vernauntor
rites.text: Twin wanderers perform shared maneuvers together when standing side by side. These joint techniques open paths, reach hidden spots, and sometimes let one partner squeeze through a gap, splitting the pair until they rejoin.

rites.name: Valaustia
rites.text: Two linked fighters unleash a combined strike that depends on timed, precise responses during its unfolding motion. Stumbles along the way weaken the blow or halt it, and a fighter who is incapacitated or hindered cannot join in.

rites.name: Meolum
rites.text: A nimble tumbling technique that a young swinger may learn from an elder mentor at a noisy workshop after buying a tonic for it. Once mastered, it lets the practitioner float briefly on a rush of air.

rites.name: Corerum
rites.text: A forceful offensive technique that appears only within one contest sport. A chosen wielder can use it, and others may unlock it after meeting certain conditions.

rites.name: Seroreoles
rites.text: A ruler reverts beings to earlier forms of their lineage, sometimes stripping away wits as well. It is applied as punishment and can be carried in a handheld device.

rites.name: Sores
rites.text: A heavy strike that a bruiser-beast unleashes during a contest, hurling an explosive burst across the court to overwhelm the opponent's return.

rites.name: Nauntium
rites.text: A learned technique that a wanderer can master after obtaining a crimson emblem from an early trial. Using it drains a fixed reserve of spiritual energy.

rites.name: Taullia
rites.text: A stored tingling energy that clings to a fighter, lifting their striking power for a short while. It marks a body that has gathered a crackling charge to be spent in a blow.

rites.name: Cenilum
rites.text: A joint twin-strike technique where one ally starts the attack by spending nine points of stored spirit energy. Its blasts land on foes chosen at random.

rites.name: Lorneostor
rites.text: A great beast charges fire inside its mouth, then unleashes it at the right moment to scorch every foe in sight. Some enemies shrug off the heat, while others are only partly harmed by it.

rites.name: Nonum
rites.text: A held technique that a wanderer can unleash once a reserve of gathered starlight has filled two segments. It is only taught after the wanderer recovers a second luminous shard.

rites.name: Risostor
rites.text: A practiced rhythm technique performed by a brawny jungle ape striking twin drums. It can be acquired at a traveling instrument stall where the ape demonstrates it on his drums.

rites.name: Melum
rites.text: A grand convergence of thirteen mingled marvels erupts in a single fierce moment. It serves as a climactic spectacle within a final warlord's rampage.

rites.name: Seriantes
rites.text: A quiet mood that does not sharpen a bearer's skill but slowly mends their wounds over time. It is one of four moods a wanderer may carry into struggle.

rites.name: Solia
rites.text: A ferocious technique that a large, armored brute alone can perform. It is a special strike reserved for that one fighter and cannot be learned by anyone else.

rites.name: Tasanum Oreleosum
rites.text: A transformation that lets its bearer hurl a single curving throwing blade at a time. It strikes foes, shatters incoming missiles, and gathers distant trinkets, and the blade can be leapt over so it sweeps back and forth before being caught.

rites.name: Telanum Laleonum
rites.text: A twin-brother combat technique where one sibling hammers the other into a small form, then the pair spin like a top to strike a foe repeatedly. Each strike lands by chance, and mastery unlocks a stronger finishing blow.

rites.name: Ceonestanum
rites.text: A winged courier unleashes a sudden volley from the air, drawing on reserved spirit energy. It can only be called upon once the courier has reached its highest level of mastery.

rites.name: Sonintum
rites.text: A shared reserve of energy that two companions draw upon to perform combined techniques in battle. It refills as the pair grow stronger, and certain tonics or healing rites restore it fully.

rites.name: Masanum
rites.text: A fast forward dash that a small monkey warrior can perform after drinking a bitter brew from an old elder. The technique is learned within a dense jungle ruin.

rites.name: Sauror
rites.text: A hidden trick that lets a traveler leap in reverse by exploiting a flaw in the movement of the world. It is treated as both a clever shortcut and a forbidden exploit.

rites.name: Ceosillia
rites.text: A bright channeled discharge of stored spirit, cast by a hollow wooden wanderer as a first formal incantation. It strikes foes with focused radiance.

rites.name: Teleorintus
rites.text: A companion's trained technique that quietly amplifies a fellow traveler's power during a clash. It counts as one of the spells this wanderer can call upon.

rites.name: Telaurnanum
rites.text: A battle card that lets a warrior leap with iron force, and it is found in the world of the Color Splash saga. Its power can be drawn out twice over in a single use.

rites.name: Valaulasia
rites.text: A whirling gust technique used by a wandering healer to spin the body and scatter nearby foes in unpredictable directions. It pulls enemies inward while spinning and lets the user drift sideways and climb higher.

rites.name: Amollisor
rites.text: A dormant, unused technique sealed within the old scripts of a distant realm. It shares its appearance and sounds with a common draining attack, but it instantly ends the life of every ally it touches.

rites.name: Viasirnus
rites.text: A coordinated assault in which a ruler calls down a flood of small, mushroom-footed creatures that swarm over the enemy. It appears in a story of a stolen body and its later retelling.

rites.name: Amarnor
rites.text: A heavy strike that a hulking horned warlord performs by leaping forward and crashing down onto his foes. It replaces an older clawing technique and is carried over into several later editions.

rites.name: Amiantia
rites.text: A rider who follows closely behind another racer and holds that spot gains a short burst of speed. The burst ends after a few seconds or when the rider strikes an obstacle, rival, or pickup.

rites.name: Orollia
rites.text: A tunneling technique that lets two companions spin into the ground and burrow through obstacles. It was first used by the smallest members of a traveling pair and later taught to the full-sized duo.

rites.name: Vanentum
rites.text: A small monkey's strumming attack that a traveling sound-merchant sells for the price of a stringed instrument. It lets the wielder unleash a jolt of rhythmic force.

rites.name: Serauria
rites.text: A brothers' combined technique that calls down a great glowing star onto one foe. The pair must strike matching colored marks in rhythm while steering a guiding sprite that keeps the star on course.

rites.name: Sonteorus
rites.text: A creature-like technique where a wielder rapidly churns their limbs in midair until they hover and glide upward briefly. It can stretch a leap or slow a fall, and usually cannot be repeated until the wielder touches solid footing again.

rites.name: Serialinor
rites.text: A spinning maneuver a turtle-like companion performs once it reaches its highest proficiency. It drains a small portion of the user's reserve energy each time it is unleashed.

rites.name: Mistium
rites.text: A timed overworld maneuver in which a wanderer drops a heavy blow from above. Its variant in the earlier version carries a different name.

rites.name: Cornus
rites.text: A coordinated embrace technique that a gentle healer performs to restore strength to her companions. Using it draws on a small reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Ameolliror
rites.text: A practiced charm that a shadowed companion weaves over a foe, drawing on a small reserve of inner energy. It can only be called upon once the companion has grown to the highest tier of skill.

rites.name: Ceollaurus
rites.text: A learned technique a small wandering ally uses to steal a foe's attention and pull a fleeting boon out of them. It is taught as a default trick known to one companion.

rites.name: Tesor
rites.text: A single harsh tactic that one fighter alone can employ in battle. It is known only to a lone combatant and marks a bold, unyielding stance.

rites.name: Teliles
rites.text: A bonded wielder calls upon a gathered surge of strength in a moment of need. Its drink can be bought from a wayside alchemist's workshop in the hollow crystal grottos for a handful of golden tokens.

rites.name: Ameoliror
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which one twin shapes flaming sparks while the other strikes them, forging a blazing mass that is driven into a foe. Practiced long enough, it unlocks a more forceful form that gathers the sparks overhead.

rites.name: Valeontor
rites.text: A tactic that lets a wanderer break away from a clash and slip past the foe, who stays frozen for a brief moment. Some foes may use it too, especially those carrying rich rewards.

rites.name: Amonor
rites.text: A swimming craft in which a wearer kicks the legs together in a rippling motion to move through water swiftly. It is taught as a knack carried on a small charm worn by the swimmer.

rites.name: Coriles
rites.text: A ruler of a wandering troupe can halt all motion around them in an instant. This gift marks them as a champion of the arena contests.

rites.name: Valistones
rites.text: A companion's default special technique that a character can call upon during a fight. It unleashes a rushing blast of wind against enemies.

rites.name: Orasellia
rites.text: A powerful technique a great ape learns after drinking a brewed tonic from an elder of the old mountain forge. It must be purchased with seven carved tokens.

rites.name: Maustialles
rites.text: A coiled pulse of borrowed starlight that a wooden puppet-warrior releases to strike the enemy with a binding flare. It is one of the spell-like techniques the puppet can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Vantum
rites.text: A quick charged rush performed by a glowing spark-spirit, striking foes without spending any inner energy. It is the spirit's most basic form of assault.

rites.name: Ceollium Corianollia
rites.text: A defensive stance that a fighter takes to lessen the harm of an incoming blow. It is learned early on by some travelers and becomes a standard skill for all later journeys.

rites.name: Sirialium
rites.text: A faint art of slipping beyond sight, granted by a trial set in scorched sands. It marks those who pass the test of hidden passage.

rites.name: Amosum
rites.text: A volatile state that overtakes a fighter who has absorbed too much harm, doubling both the blows they land and the blows they suffer. It fades when a restorative herb is consumed, time passes, or all foes nearby fall.

rites.name: Amauntiasum
rites.text: A recurring affliction that locks a bearer's limbs in icy stillness, leaving them unable to act until the chill breaks. It first appears in an early chapter of the adventure.

rites.name: Oriastanum
rites.text: A dreamer's craft that lets a twin-like figure inside a sleeper's mind alter objects by touching marked spots on a shifting face. Certain dream-wells in the realm grant special versions of it.

rites.name: Rostium
rites.text: A small sugary technique that a wanderer can call upon for little effort. It is granted once a sealed ancient map is unlocked.

rites.name: Coraunus
rites.text: A quiet mental art that lets its user glance inside another's thoughts. It is one of the spells a young wielder of the cloud-folk can learn.

rites.name: Ciallia
rites.text: A companion may climb to a higher standing after receiving a special empowering charm. Once raised, it gains more techniques in struggles and hits harder, and in later forms its vitality also grows.

rites.name: Relor
rites.text: A signature technique used by one rival fighter, and only during a single optional duel with them. It marks the fighter's personal style in that encounter.

rites.name: Lolausum
rites.text: A sudden burst of ruinous force that a champion of the household unleashes as a last resort. It strikes foes caught in its reach and marks the moment a fighter's final power is loosed.

rites.name: Reosium
rites.text: A tactic in which a wary foe slips past a strike at the last instant, shrugging off the blow with a taunt. Practitioners use it to frustrate attackers and to reveal an opponent's timing.

rites.name: Telestum Caurornus
rites.text: A small explosive companion unleashes its most powerful blast, but only after spending a costly reserve of inner energy. It can perform this strongest technique once it has reached its highest level of training.

rites.name: Valestia
rites.text: A small pocket of shrinking power that a young hero may draw upon after purchasing a tonic from an old merchant. It lets the wielder take on a much smaller form for a short while.

rites.name: Nirneoses
rites.text: A radiant energy that a teacher spirit grants to a wanderer, letting them unleash unique combat techniques. Later tales abandon it, so those special arts vanish from the land.

rites.name: Teornes
rites.text: A stronger form of a twin-fighter's shared technique that can be enhanced mid-strike by a quick secondary input. Once mastered, a mark appears beside it to show it has been learned.

rites.name: Meosolum
rites.text: A soothing technique used by certain foes that lulls a target into a drowsy stupor. It is wielded by some hostile creatures and their chieftains in battle.

rites.name: Seralum
rites.text: A fiery attack that fires two swirling streams of flame forward, dragging opponents along with them. Later hits are stronger and can knock foes away, and the flames leave lingering fire on any platforms they touch.

rites.name: Cintes
rites.text: A hidden technique that a wielder performs in battle to strike with a special assault. It is known only to those who have discovered its secret.

rites.name: Ternus
rites.text: A companion's playful distraction technique drains a small reserve of bloom energy to dazzle foes. It only becomes available once the companion has reached its highest tier of training.

rites.name: Vintaullum
rites.text: A tricky maneuver a fighter performs only after seizing a foe, using three forceful throws. Certain towering guardians can be harmed solely by this grappling technique.

rites.name: Coronum
rites.text: A coordinated volley of conjured spells summoned by a mage-caster, costing a fixed amount of spirit energy to unleash. It is one of a warlord's signature battle techniques.

rites.name: Coralornium
rites.text: A two-person maneuver where one partner is hurled through the air to strike a foe feet-first, and the pair can spin together to snatch belongings from the target. Mastering it unlocks a more elaborate version.

rites.name: Lausenor
rites.text: A forceful technique that only certain stone-bodied brawlers can perform. It is wielded by a single fighter and by clay-like guardians of the same kind.

rites.name: Restium
rites.text: A quiet technique a silver-tongued courier may learn as their skill grows, drawing on a reserve of inner energy. It is performed by spinning a guiding stone rapidly in the hand.

rites.name: Lelases
rites.text: A bearer swells enormous through a sudden surge of borrowed might. The swelling mirrors a greater transformation, and the surge works just as it does for a rival bearer of the same art.

rites.name: Serellus
rites.text: A practiced defensive art in which a fighter steadies their guard against incoming blows. It is used by the party members of a traveling adventure.

rites.name: Cenalia
rites.text: A powerful heavy-hitting technique that a great ape learns from an old elder in a sun-baked mountain shrine. It must be bought with a small sum of golden tokens.

rites.name: Minor
rites.text: A coordinated three-person maneuver that spins through every foe on the field. It draws on a set amount of shared energy and strikes all opposing figures at once.

rites.name: Rinium
rites.text: A paired technique in which two companions join in a shared dash across the field. Its use requires a fixed cost of points to set it in motion.

rites.name: Seornus Sauntor
rites.text: A defensive strike technique used by a greedy rogue in a sporting contest of racquets and courts. It lets the wielder send back an incoming shot with extra force.

rites.name: Naseornium
rites.text: A companion's highest standing, reached after long bonding. Those who attain it gain their finest techniques and greater striking force, and their vitality swells with each advance.

rites.name: Vostantor
rites.text: A fighter leaps skyward and strikes a stance within a green whirlwind, then drives a ball into the net trailing bright swirling streaks. It is a finishing technique used in ball sports.

rites.name: Sereolasia
rites.text: A defensive power move used by a shelled creature during a sporting contest, returning the ball with a surge of water. It is a sideline technique for protecting one's position on the court.

rites.name: Nilum
rites.text: A powerful signature throw wielded by a winged athlete during team sport contests. It is unleashed as a special shot.

rites.name: Liantor Verolum
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a racquet-wielding fighter deflects an incoming powerful blow with a spinning counterstroke. It belongs to the arsenal of a sky-dwelling tactician.

rites.name: Lornus Tonistanum
rites.text: A hulking forest brawler strikes a bright chime instrument to unleash a rhythmic stomp. The art can be bought from a shopkeeper who sells music in a clanging workshop district.

rites.name: Oriasanum
rites.text: A bonus that flows to each companion while they stand ready in the group and remain upright. It is earned by keeping a sequence of precise timed presses unbroken, and it strengthens gauges and stats in increasing steps.

rites.name: Meostanium
rites.text: A creature leaps skyward and crashes down onto the ground, striking foes below and scattering bursts of light to each side. It can be unleashed mid-air as well, and it has two stronger variant forms.

rites.name: Reostes
rites.text: A mounted warrior and their young rider charge across the field on a huge missile-shaped beast, striking every foe three times. The maneuver is the second skill taught to the duo and costs seven points of energy.

rites.name: Corelia
rites.text: A protective bubble that a wearer can raise around themselves. It blocks a single incoming strike, then fades away once it has absorbed the blow.

rites.name: Valauranum
rites.text: Elders guide a chosen wielder to a training ground where the powers of a transformation are taught. Only the power taught by that elder can be used there, and the lesson can be repeated whenever one wishes.

rites.name: Serellines
rites.text: A climber in midair can press to leap again by hurling a carried stone downward, which pushes the climber higher. Only one such leap works before touching ground again.

rites.name: Veoranum
rites.text: Three allies unleash a combined assault in which flames, frost, and crackling bolts fly together, followed by a heavy blast that strikes foes harder when they are vulnerable to those forces.

rites.name: Nestallium
rites.text: A folded paper transformation that lets a wanderer glide over waterways untouched, though rough swells can push the vessel back. It is bestowed as a binding hex by a chest-bound fiend and can be dismissed only by touching a matching marker.

rites.name: Maunanum Serialum
rites.text: A small-bodied fighter hurls itself into a spinning sideways tumble to bowl over foes. It can clear a whole line of weaker enemies at once, but it fails against heavy or spiky foes and leaders.

rites.name: Reornum
rites.text: A recurring hand-technique where a wielder lifts a companion or object to carry it to a destination or hurl it as a missile. The hold is made in front of the body or raised overhead, and the control shares a button with running or striking.

rites.name: Corinentum
rites.text: A bound-hand affliction that a particular masked hooligan can lay upon a traveler, shaking their life gauge and freezing them for a few rounds. While bound, the victim cannot act or guard, and a paint-sprayer nearby soaks them at once.

rites.name: Serelaurum
rites.text: A reserve of charged energy that a wearer spends to unleash powerful combined strikes. Its capacity grows as the wearer gains strength and finer garments, and certain garb lowers what each strike costs.

rites.name: Sonerium
rites.text: A moving-upward craft used on ladders, vines, chains, and poles, as well as along walls and ceilings. Descending by it is often quicker than rising, and some creatures can perform it too.

rites.name: Tauses Tiastanum
rites.text: A small blue cup of drink that clears away harmful afflictions from one companion during a fight, letting them return to combat. It cannot be used once a battle has ended.

rites.name: Tellaurium
rites.text: Dark wisps are spat from the maws of bog brutes and drift briefly before coalescing into a homing blight. Striking them back at their source hurts the spitter.

rites.name: Sistor
rites.text: A ritual burst of flame that a festive cake-warrior unleashes once all its candles are kindled. It sweeps across every foe at once and cannot be warded off.

rites.name: Mosia
rites.text: A defender strikes back against an incoming blow during the foe's turn, dodging or answering it for extra harm. Each foe gives a telling flicker before its strike, and reading those signs lets the fighter time the response.

rites.name: Visaustor
rites.text: A commanding leader's call that unleashes a sudden gale from a fused, many-limbed beast. The rush of wind briefly sweeps some companions out of the fight.

rites.name: Serilor Corianelus
rites.text: A passive gift that a hero receives when one of four named companions travels with them. It raises the chance of landing strong blows with weapons, and its strength depends on the companion's current level.

rites.name: Norus
rites.text: A paired duo heats one partner's back until a fiery burst launches them both forward faster than usual. It helps cross timed gaps, slip past swift hazards, shove heavy blocks, and smash weakened barriers.

rites.name: Amentium
rites.text: A defensive technique where a fighter splits into several mirrored forms that circle the strike zone. The final form is the one that returns the incoming strike.

rites.name: Valosia Coranisum
rites.text: A soft drowsy hush spreads over every foe nearby, freezing them in place until a blow jolts them awake. The stillness fades on its own after a single passing turn, and the hush needs a long rest before it can be called again.

rites.name: Teornum
rites.text: A fighter whose life force has run out collapses motionless and cannot act until revived by a restorative charm or craft. Once the clash ends, the fallen are brought back with a sliver of strength, unless the battle was lost entirely.

rites.name: Orirnantia
rites.text: A climber catches the rim of a raised ledge while falling and hauls itself up and over, rolling as it lands. The rolling motion gathers bright tokens and knocks aside any foe it touches.

rites.name: Oreornia Laurornes
rites.text: A passive guard that a bearer gains while a certain frost-spirit companion walks beside them. It softens harm from elemental afflictions and grants steady resistance against chilling sickness, with its strength tied to the companion's rank.

rites.name: Vastanum
rites.text: A rare strike unleashed by a shadowy ally once every fourth round, once all of its guardian shards have shattered. It hits one chosen foe with crushing force, yet can be parried, and ignores the charms that normally shield against fatal blows.

rites.name: Orintosor
rites.text: A temporary affliction that reverses a bearer's control inputs for a brief span. It fades on its own after a little while, or is ended at once by a cleansing charm, and can be cast by hexing relics or spread through certain cursed dishes.

rites.name: Tostes Ceollosor
rites.text: A fighter hops twice, then springs skyward wrapped in fire and smashes down on the ball, sending it across the field at great speed. Anyone who returns it is hurled far backward from their spot.

rites.name: Valarium
rites.text: A tiered memory test where a seeker pairs hidden tokens behind a drape within a short time limit. Success builds up an inner sight that later strengthens a practitioner's signature strike.

rites.name: Ralia Amialanum
rites.text: A group of riders moving together forms a ring of gathering force around them. Within the ring, mounts recover their endurance faster and move quicker than any rider traveling alone.

rites.name: Meolia Orostianes
rites.text: A heavy-set brute reels back a massive hammer and drives it upward in a rising strike. A quick swipe of the hand increases the force and reward, and the blow sends foes staggering backward.

rites.name: Senaullium
rites.text: A forceful shove that flings a struck being backward, bouncing it off nearby barriers and cracking them. The shoved being can in turn send others sliding, even hurling them past the edge of the field.

rites.name: Valausor
rites.text: A bouncy, spiky creature form that a wandering hero briefly takes on when a magic bloom touches them. Its tall leaping grants great height and it can strike foes from beneath, but each hit shrinks it back down.

rites.name: Tarus Siror
rites.text: A ready-to-use burst of invulnerability that a brawler can unleash once he has gathered twenty tokens of fortune. While it lasts he moves faster and smashes through several barriers at once.

rites.name: Serintum Coraularnia
rites.text: A restorative craft in which a practitioner mends their own wounds and those of companions standing nearby, each recovering a share of their full vitality.

rites.name: Rauranum
rites.text: A craft of striking targets in a fixed succession so that a launched thing bounces along a set route. The practitioner plans the path from one chosen anchor point.

rites.name: Neosanum Oreostirnus
rites.text: A stronger rolling charge that keeps carrying its wielder forward until it strikes something solid or simply fades. It needs a companion's aid to unleash, and resembles an older tumbling assault once shared by a pair of allies.

rites.name: Meostium
rites.text: A companion-powered burst that a pair of brawlers unleash once a gathered store fills. It transforms every foe on the screen into a rewarding trinket, and cannot be used while mounted, caged, or carrying something.

rites.name: Lenia Vellor
rites.text: A charged state that a fighter can reach by fusing a heavy power token with a companion's charm. It swells the force of that fighter's next strike only, marked by rising sparks or flames around them.

rites.name: Telaustor Nistanium
rites.text: A training ritual where a wielder strikes falling stone tiles before they reach a marked danger line, building up a leaping charge. Tiles appear in groups, and the trainee must clear a set quota without any time limit.

rites.name: Veontor Vonasor
rites.text: A quick airborne maneuver performed by pressing a button just after leaving a launch ramp. Pressing it lets the racer spring forward with extra speed.

rites.name: Sistanum
rites.text: A paid service where a merchant's face turns into a huge pair of lips that smack a foe before the fight begins. The merchant then leaves, and the enemy is left weakened for the coming struggle.

rites.name: Orinolanum
rites.text: A bonded power that calls forth a great shaggy beast to send a crashing wave through foes within a set reach. It must rest for three turns before it can be called again, and its force grows with the caller's rising skill.

rites.name: Orenes Rarnollium
rites.text: A companion's whistled tune guides a traveler toward hidden paths and sings open sealed stones. Nearby birds are drawn to the melody, and a trail of notes marks the way ahead.

rites.name: Ciales Orianes
rites.text: A borrowed guise worn by a trio of travelers to slip past a crew of raiders. It is passed on through a stabbing from a spear, and a performance on stage tends to draw the suspicion of onlookers.

rites.name: Orestus Nernium
rites.text: A bearer unlocks a costly sustained surge that heightens the strike force of its user and nearby companions for one full round. Companions may then move away and act while the surge still holds.

rites.name: Serollor
rites.text: Two paired wanderers each gain strengths on a shared climb, one growing swifter and sharper while the other grows sturdier. Their rank rises at set thresholds, and the effort each step demands grows steadily harder as they climb.

rites.name: Corialarium
rites.text: A hero hurls a flowing garment like a blade, slicing a hidden weak point in a giant beast and bringing it down. Captives who spill out are snatched away by a rival lord.

rites.name: Vantonor
rites.text: A ghost-wielder channels hidden energy to surround themselves in a violet glow, which risks exposing their position. A full charge opens purple gateways that drain the light from enemies caught within them.

rites.name: Amauntes Riastirnes
rites.text: A rhythmic tune performed to make a rising fungal shelf grow tall enough to escape a sealed pit. Its tempo drives the ascent, and its lively melody ends with a leap from a hollow trunk.

rites.name: Nenium Coraurnanum
rites.text: A bearer can turn edge-on and slip through narrow gaps, but moves sluggishly and cannot wield weapons or call on companions while flattened.

rites.name: Voleores
rites.text: A lightning-touched condition that freezes a bearer in place for a few moments, leaving them unable to act. It is shown by a small bolt mark and can spread through shocks and surges.

rites.name: Rantes Leoses
rites.text: A fighter raises a star-shaped barrier against an incoming beam, sending the ray straight back at its caster. The defense turns the attacker's own power against them.

rites.name: Riantus Valerum
rites.text: A two-figure hand technique lets small explorers tug at things in their path to set off switches, free loose goods, and knock out foes. Stubborn objects must be tugged several times, turning redder with each pull before finally yielding.

rites.name: Corelor
rites.text: A tumbling leap that replaces ordinary jumps and their variants. Practitioners flip through the air, which makes them move faster and travel farther.

rites.name: Amasolanum
rites.text: Sudden, comical status changes that befall a wandering brute after striking hazardous foes or traps. They alter how the character moves and acts, often wearing off after a set time or being undone by touching water.

rites.name: Valauntanum
rites.text: A short, forward burst performed by a diver who presses a key while sinking through deep water. The swimmer stretches both arms ahead and sweeps them down, shooting straight along the current, but cannot steer mid-dash and is stunned on striking a barrier.

rites.name: Niranum Serornia
rites.text: A restorative craft channeled by a pulsing caster that brings fallen allies back to a fraction of their vitality within a short reach. Each use must rest for several rounds before it can be called again.

rites.name: Riarnia Veonum
rites.text: A small wooden figure drops onto all fours and scrambles up any incline, even steep ones that would send others sliding back down. The skill opens a hidden gate reached after drawing a red beam, and it is often used to reach rewards perched high on sharp slopes.

rites.name: Orisus Telaulares
rites.text: A small charm that lets its wearer store strength in a striking tool across several turns. Each stored charge boosts the next blow, and the stored power is spent all at once.

rites.name: Telanolus
rites.text: A defensive technique in which falling fiery stones sweep across the user's half of the field, letting the wielder loop a returning strike back over the opponent's head.

rites.name: Amastaullor
rites.text: A crackling affliction that makes a struck being suffer repeated harm, and nearby allies suffer it too. The strength of the first blow sets how much repeated harm follows.

rites.name: Lornus Teleontium
rites.text: A fiery rain of falling stones batters everything inside a ring around the caster, wounding foes several times over. Afterward the caster recovers a share of the harm dealt, and the ritual must rest three rounds before reuse.

rites.name: Lintastum
rites.text: A defensive technique that lets a fighter conjure a sticky woven net to snare an incoming strike. The snared strike is then flung back toward the opponent, allowing a clean return.

rites.name: Masteres
rites.text: A three-part combined maneuver used by a leader, a healer and a leaping ally together. The shell-bearer spins, a thrown light strikes him, and he flies through every foe on the field.

rites.name: Nanus
rites.text: A brute learns a sliding punch that lets him reach ledges and break heavy stones. It lets him move across a moving belt in reverse and continue a long trek.

rites.name: Amesanum Orauntiales
rites.text: A small wicked prince summons a flying carriage that sails across the field carrying a heap of provisions. When the signal is pressed, the load tumbles down and mends the wounds of nearby companions, though a missed signal wastes both the effort and the charge.

rites.name: Conor Orastus
rites.text: A water-bound craft in which a creature sends three rolling pressure waves outward from itself across a broad reach. It must rest for several rounds before using it again, and the force of each wave grows with the strength of those nearby.

rites.name: Lirnus Valaurnasor
rites.text: A combined technique in which three allies call down a luminous celestial token that forms shining bridges for them to race along. They leap skyward and unleash coordinated blasts of fire, lightning, and light that burst upon a single foe.

rites.name: Rosistium
rites.text: A combined attack in which a towering brute hurls two companions skyward, and one of them sends a glittering barrage of falling lights down upon the foes below.

rites.name: Seontirnor
rites.text: A gliding technique a wanderer triggers by shaking a handheld device while crossing icy ground. The traveler moves faster and keeps sliding until bumping into something solid or dropping into a pounding landing.

rites.name: Mialum
rites.text: A tactical maneuver that freezes a companion or foe just as it readies its signature technique, dealing slight harm and halting every linked attacker when used against a combined assault. Using it when no foe is preparing anything wastes a point of leadership.

rites.name: Volleontor
rites.text: A bonding hex that pins a creature in place for several turns. Anyone struck by the binding takes harm at once if the blow landed cleanly.

rites.name: Siasanum
rites.text: A spinning attack wrapped in a haze of drifting melodic motes. The striker releases a curved blow that leaves the opponent dazed in rapid pulses.

rites.name: Callirnus
rites.text: A quick tune that accompanies a dash out of a locked chamber, slipping past clumsy guards and fiery hunters. In a later telling it climbs higher as companions outrun a rising tide of molten stone.

rites.name: Merisus
rites.text: A lively tune that accompanies several short contests of skill and spinning play. It is heard across a handful of different challenges, each played for quick amusement.

rites.name: Rauranum Serum
rites.text: A chilling burst of three rings rolls outward from a wielder, striking foes nearby and leaving them numbed by creeping cold. It recharges slowly and reaches a shorter distance than similar blasts.

rites.name: Niastilia Vaulus
rites.text: A charged burst of motion that a companion beast releases to dash or leap into out-of-reach places. It can smash through barriers and plow through foes until it strikes a solid wall.

rites.name: Riles Rauranum
rites.text: A swinging strike performed by a shapeshifted wanderer using a long rear appendage. It sweeps through foes and objects standing within reach at waist height, and a related spinning version exists in a winged form.

rites.name: Molles Corillor
rites.text: A bonding state that holds a bearer in place for a short span of turns. It is applied only by a single adhesive token and brings no added harm to the one it grips.

rites.name: Ceontor Sernium
