rites.text: A coordinated three-person technique that lets fighters seize distant objects and trigger mechanisms from afar. It is the third such technique taught in the Tidewhorl Depths.

rites.name: Coreseostor
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a student trains a trembling motion of the whole chamber, aiming to make the floor quake when a dropped object strikes it. It is the sixth lesson of the green training circle.

rites.name: Ceorolles
rites.text: Two siblings join hands in a bond of charged current, and one is seized by crackling force that locks them into a shared stride. They drift forward together, slowed and unable to turn, yet they slip through narrow openings and reach objects that demand a backward glance.

rites.name: Molum Coresaurum
rites.text: A trio of companions launch into a synchronized leap that carries them farther across the gap and hangs them briefly in the air. It cannot climb as high, and it can reach farther than an ordinary jump.

rites.name: Valiarnores
rites.text: A user raises protective charges of shielding around themselves and nearby companions. Each blow strikes away one charge, sparing its bearer from harm, and the ward recharges only after several turns.

rites.name: Orontes
rites.text: A closing rite that scatters bright drifting flecks into the air whenever a short contest is won. Practitioners learn it as the fifth craft in their green training circle.

rites.name: Teleorium Tellaurium
rites.text: A runner bounds automatically over low barriers and small pits while standing on the ground. Hopping over foes halts them and yields glowing sparks that feed a sprint challenge.

rites.name: Verum Corillonus
rites.text: A vast, many-hued beam of light that a winged guardian fires in a single decisive moment. It breaks a shield around a fortress, leaving the guardian drained and unable to act for the rest of the tale.

rites.name: Meornasor
rites.text: A companion learns to send rippling sonar pulses that shove or shatter certain blocks and trigger hidden switches. Later, an upgrade lets repeated pulses coax climbing vines to sprout at specific spots.

rites.name: Laustentia
rites.text: A piercing burst that shoves nearby foes outward from the wielder in a ring. It recharges slowly and grows wider as the user gains strength.

rites.name: Miirora
rites.text: Miirora is a rite of the Walled Age in which the first sovereign's heralds sang a boundary into the grove-soil, and the land answered by rising into walls of living stone. The event bound the scattered groves into a single kingdom and is still recalled at every crossing of a border.

rites.name: Maulleontus
rites.text: A nimble manoeuvre that lets a competitor scale a barrier and reach an upper ledge. It recurs across several sporting contests held within the same tournament-based world.

rites.name: Mistus
rites.text: A measured skill that lets a fighter land a devastating strike by chance. It is honed through the handling of a weapon and reflects how keenly the wielder reads an opening.

rites.name: Cilleosium
rites.text: A tactical maneuver any character can perform in the tabletop-style battles of a fantasy realm. It lets a fighter call for a hearing or a plea, shifting the flow of a confrontation.

rites.name: Teliantes
rites.text: A small creature can dart swiftly in any direction in a sudden burst of motion. The move does not harm others when used.

rites.name: Serauntanum
rites.text: A lingering condition that lets a fighter spring back into motion after a leap. It is a passing effect that marks a creature as airborne and ready to hop again.

rites.name: Cosaulor
rites.text: Two siblings bounce together, one hurling the other skyward before a midair grab and a twisting dive. The lighter partner then slams down onto a foe with both fists.

rites.name: Liaria
rites.text: A chosen strongman unleashes a crushing forward-hurling strike from his bulk. It is a signature finishing technique among the league's brawling champions.

rites.name: Vantes
rites.text: A swinging technique a fierce beast-keeper uses to strike the orb. It takes the place of an older, odd strike, which in turn gives way to a pulling strike.

rites.name: Meosor
rites.text: Riders perform flashy midair motions after leaving a ramp, shaking their controls to pull off stunts. Landing them grants a quick speed surge that also helps earn better standings.

rites.name: Soneosia
rites.text: A spinning headbutt technique that a fighter performs to strike foes with a rotating blow. It belongs to the set of special maneuvers a warrior can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Ceosium
rites.text: A tilting force lets travelers roll flat against a surface, so their view turns upside down or sideways. Marked blue panels with ringed edges mark where the effect applies, and collisions sometimes send riders forward in a burst.

rites.name: Sernausium
rites.text: A leaping craft in which a wearer springs high by hurling a hat-like covering into the air. The covering then carries the wearer onward through a brief, lofty bound.

rites.name: Tiasia
rites.text: A short timed amusement that plays out as a playful stage of mannered social jesting. It is played using a bold, oversized crowd-pleasing posture.

rites.name: Villarnia
rites.text: A hand-slapping motion that a jungle ape uses to snatch nearby fruit or strike foes, triggered by a sound picked up by a drum-shaped controller. It can also serve as a defensive rhythm against a giant beast's blows.

rites.name: Oraurum
rites.text: A powerful strike technique practiced by a great ape warrior, passed down by an elder teacher. It is learned in a jungle grove after earning three bronze tokens of merit.

rites.name: Rosium
rites.text: A bending craft lets a wielder fold space and time around themselves, moving freely and overpowering rivals by drawing on a sealed crystal of raw energy.

rites.name: Ciastelus
rites.text: A technique that unleashes a sudden barrage of sharp projectiles upon an enemy. It appears in several adventures and is also performed in a lively sporting contest.

rites.name: Telanum
rites.text: A tactical card that lets a fighter leap across a long distance in a single bound. It is used during combat to reach distant foes.

rites.name: Sauniasor
rites.text: A returning throw used in defense, where a thrown curved fruit-shaped projectile swings back toward its sender after striking the ground. It is a special shot that a wild primate fighter uses to answer incoming strikes.

rites.name: Amalausor
rites.text: A sweeping technique belonging to a towering, fire-breathing brute of the arena. It is the signature strike that the brute uses in the sport of bat-and-ball contests.

rites.name: Serontes
rites.text: A forceful strike technique drawn from a sprawling rally-sport tournament, used by a segmented caterpillar-like sportsman to launch a fierce offensive shot.

rites.name: Taunum
rites.text: A battle maneuver in which a heavy iron-clad fighter leaps forward to strike an enemy with crushing force. It is drawn from a deck of combat cards.

rites.name: Caureolus
rites.text: A recurring hurried gait used in play, where the wanderer moves swiftly and can leap a little farther than usual, helping them cross a stage more quickly.

rites.name: Teontum
rites.text: A lineup bond lets certain companions in a sporting team gain special joint maneuvers when they stand side by side in the batting order.

rites.name: Caurnium
rites.text: A ghostly defensive strike used by a spectral sprite in a sporting duel. It lets the caster send back incoming shots with eerie precision.

rites.name: Amianalles
rites.text: A heavy strike that a sturdy beast delivers by slowly lifting its skull and then slamming it down. Anyone struck is pressed into the earth, and a falling foe is driven straight to the ground, while shields can be crushed.

rites.name: Caulesanum
rites.text: A bearer can strike twice with a quick pair of blows, stunning or felling foes nearby. The strike works on the ground and breaks certain sealed objects, while the body's upward rise delivers harm but the descent does not.

rites.name: Veollanor
rites.text: A racer keeps pace through a bend by sliding the vehicle sideways while steering. Releasing the slide can give a brief surge of speed.

rites.name: Oreontausum
rites.text: A quick bounding leap that carts, cycles, and hovering sleds can perform by tapping a single control. It is mainly used to slide through turns and to clear small gaps along a route.

rites.name: Mistum
rites.text: A batter's signature swing that wraps a striking hero's strength in blazing heat. It takes the place of an older, simpler technique, yet the same hero still draws on it when throwing the ball.

rites.name: Restes
rites.text: A tender swinging technique used by a royal figure with a bat, now reserved only for throwing pitches. It once served as a different sort of strike in an earlier contest.

rites.name: Meseontanum
rites.text: A ruler's borrowed amulet lets him take on a blazing orange form that hurls fireballs from his palms. The amulet later breaks apart from overuse, ending the ability for good.

rites.name: Tausiantor
rites.text: A signature hitting technique of a royal sphere-striker, used in a sporting contest. It takes the place of an older pitching-style maneuver, which is kept only for delivering throws.

rites.name: Relanum
rites.text: A spinning maneuver that appears in several interactive adventures, most prominently within one sequence of linked titles. It first shows up in the earliest installment of that sequence.

rites.name: Reorasanum
rites.text: A batter's swing technique that replaces an older hitting move, and it also substitutes for a pitching delivery when a certain young character takes the mound.

rites.name: Tostaurnia
rites.text: A spare chance granted to a traveler who falls in a perilous realm of trials. When every chance is spent, the journey must restart from the beginning or from a marked resting stone.

rites.name: Viares
rites.text: A bright sphere of gathered force that is hurled as a forceful strike. It is the signature offensive technique of a winged shelled creature used in a sporting contest.

rites.name: Nausiaria
rites.text: A ferocious rhythmic drumming strike unleashed by a mighty ape warrior as his ultimate attack. It is performed in battle-arena brawls across several realms.

rites.name: Teornisus
rites.text: A bodily technique where a traveler crouches and springs onto their hands, then leaps or crawls with that inverted posture. The stance lets them slip past certain falling dangers and reach raised ledges.

rites.name: Serornintum
rites.text: A tricky launch move performed by a small raider during a sporting contest. It sends the ball flying with a burst of force toward the goal.

rites.name: Corum
rites.text: A bearer hurls their own body forward like a blazing projectile across the field, scorching any foes struck along the path. Holding the thrust longer sends the bearer farther and hits harder, though it may sometimes fail and fly the furthest of all.

rites.name: Ventorum
rites.text: A brother-pair's combined technique where one falls from above in a descending strike. It deals heavy harm to foes that are vulnerable to downward blows.

rites.name: Nalaures
rites.text: A siphoning technique used by foes and guardians to draw life from an opponent. It is a lesser form of its stronger cousin, and it burns with a hot, fiery touch.

rites.name: Manentium
rites.text: A bounding leap-state that a hero enters inside a short comic storybook installment. It briefly changes how the hero moves through the world.

rites.name: Valirestor
rites.text: A hovering glider-rider performs a final, costly dive that strikes one enemy standing on the ground. It is unlocked after gathering every fragment in a forest grove and drains a portion of the user's energy each time it is used.

rites.name: Relauntum
rites.text: A battle card that lets a traveler call forth a massive, leaping foot that stomps down on foes. It appears among the cards gathered during a painted adventure.

rites.name: Conium
rites.text: A drifting veil of murk that a gentle sky-spirit can summon once she reaches her highest tier of skill. Calling it draws on a modest reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Linelum
rites.text: A costly combined strike that one twin launches against a lone enemy. It draws heavily on a shared reserve of spirit energy.

rites.name: Oraulium
rites.text: A passing condition that quickens a bearer's movements for a short span. It is one of several temporary states that can settle over a fighter during a clash.

rites.name: Mollia
rites.text: A glowing technique wielded by a royal heir in a sporting contest, letting her hurl a ball with precise, heart-stopping force. It belongs to her signature repertoire on the court.

rites.name: Tasium
rites.text: A swimming technique in which a diver snaps the body into a rapid wave-like flick to surge forward through the water. Practitioners learn it as the first stage of a rising skill.

rites.name: Orantor
rites.text: A ferocious final technique wielded by a jungle-dwelling strongman in a clash of arena champions. It takes the place of an older ritual drumbeat once used for the same purpose.

rites.name: Nelleornum
rites.text: A devastating signature strike that unleashes a burst of vivid light. It has appeared in one winter festival of athletic contests, where it was seen only once.

rites.name: Seraures
rites.text: A heavy strike technique that a brawler drives into the ground to shake the surrounding terrain. It is performed during the shaking-focused challenges of a rough-and-tumble adventurer's journey.

rites.name: Solor
rites.text: A temporary condition that makes a bearer swell to a much larger size. It appears within a fantastical storytelling realm.

rites.name: Coranes
rites.text: A signature batting swing belonging to a dinosaur-like rider, replacing an older hitting technique and pairing with a new pitch in its place.

rites.name: Corollum
rites.text: A sacred striking technique unique to the White Mage's style, used as the special move within a three-on-three ball contest.

rites.name: Vosialium
rites.text: A swift defensive strike that a quick-footed sporting figure uses to send an incoming ball back over the net. It is a reactive technique meant to turn a near-lost rally around.

rites.name: Sereolus
rites.text: A harsher trial that opens after a champion defeats the final dream-beast, letting them restart their chronicle under stricter terms. Once a chronicle is set to this trial it stays so forever, and the only way back is to wipe the record clean.

rites.name: Seontor
rites.text: A bulky companion can drink a brewed draught from a lab shop to take on a heavier, stronger form. The brew is sold alongside a related punching technique.

rites.name: Tontaurnia
rites.text: A practiced stillness gathers a wielder's inner radiance back into their reserves. Those who learn it can deepen the recovery with added charms, and a companion may share in the gathering.

rites.name: Tialarnium
rites.text: A practiced maneuver lets a flat-bodied wanderer turn into a rounded figure at a press of a button, with the view swinging around to reveal depth. A gauge tracks how long the figure can hold that fuller shape before snapping back.

rites.name: Contialanum
rites.text: A bearer calls forth one or two copies of themself that fight beside them and vanish in a puff of smoke when struck down. Storms of lightning pass over the copies without harming them.

rites.name: Valiastasum
rites.text: A bright magical technique that a wooden puppet-like companion can cast in battle. It works as one of its spell attacks.

rites.name: Sereollus Oristiantum
rites.text: A tuned throwing or striking technique in which a ball transforms into a fast, fire-tipped missile. When pitched it loops before rushing past the striker, and when struck it streaks across the field and knocks back anyone who tries to catch it.

rites.name: Silor
rites.text: A fast, hurtling projectile launched by a clever fellow who sends a striker plunging into an opposing goal. It is a finishing move used by a mischievous rival.

rites.name: Sosia
rites.text: A bounding technique in which a figure hangs aloft mid-leap or sinks gently through the air. A flowing garment often ripples during it, and some practitioners use a canopy as a lifting wing.

rites.name: Terniallium
rites.text: A quick forward plunge that many wanderers perform to descend or strike. It first appeared in an early adventure and returned in several later journeys.

rites.name: Telianum
rites.text: A blazing projectile strike that a rival band of raiders hurls across the field. It is a single shot aimed to shatter defenses and send opponents tumbling.

rites.name: Tiallistor
rites.text: A charged burst of power is absorbed from a broken orb and stored in a warrior, lighting them with a golden glow. It unleashes its force on their next ordinary strike, and a foe who lands too many blows can shatter the orb before it is used.

rites.name: Siallium
rites.text: A violent spinning technique that a cloud-riding ally unleashes once fully mastered. It draws on a small reserve of inner energy each time it is performed.

rites.name: Valisor
rites.text: A coordinated twin-brother maneuver that spends seven charge points and calls forth a glowing egg. The egg's icon marks the technique's readiness in battle.

rites.name: Vereosus
rites.text: A ruler's ultimate power that unleashes a violent hurricane of flame across the battlefield. It is wielded by a tyrannical warlord in a sporting contest.

rites.name: Restontus
rites.text: A tiered combo move where a small hammer-wielder launches a shrunken ally like a ball into a chosen foe. Its advanced form lets the ally keep striking while the timed presses hold.

rites.name: Leontium
rites.text: A timed rite in which a healer's pale tablets rain down in rings and arcs, mirroring a far older flame-cast ritual but with restorative, shimmering pellets instead of fire.

rites.name: Veoliasium
rites.text: A striker leaps skyward, kicks a ball wrapped in a ring of flame, and sends it blazing straight into the goal. A flawless kick adds a rousing horn fanfare as the shot lands.

rites.name: Amalistia
rites.text: A closely guarded technique in which a skilled fighter unleashes a dazzling burst of stellar energy in battle. Only a single companion star-spirit is able to perform it.

rites.name: Amoneles
rites.text: A skilled technique for snatching a flying ball out of the air. It first arises in one sporting contest and later returns in a second.

rites.name: Amantinia
rites.text: A commanding technique wielded by a young rider during a journey through strange lands. It lets a first officer answer an enemy's assault with a sharp, timed rebuttal.

rites.name: Telinor
rites.text: A rising uppercut technique used by the heroic brothers and their healer ally to launch themselves skyward, striking foes along the way. It serves as the recovery and attack tool of the three fighters who wield it.

rites.name: Corauntes
rites.text: A spinning whirlwind technique that a warrior uses in combat. It first appeared in an early brawling tournament, where its wind carries the fighter across the arena.

rites.name: Ranum Laustia
rites.text: A tactic in which a catcher pulls a flying ball inward by drawing air toward their glove. It first appears under an earlier label and later returns under the name Drawgrip.

rites.name: Oreonum
rites.text: A brutal throwing technique belonging to a trio of fierce forceful maneuvers. It is used by a bulky brawler who hurls foes with overwhelming strength.

rites.name: Sosium
rites.text: A devastating technique in which a hero hurls a blazing rock from above, crashing into foes below. It is performed as a special attack that draws on the user's own inner strength.

rites.name: Tausterum
rites.text: A driver slides around a turn and then bursts forward with a brief rush of speed. Repeated slides can be chained together, zigzagging down a straight to keep momentum high.

rites.name: Veosus Sosiantium
rites.text: A powerful surge technique that a spirit companion can master after reaching its highest tier of growth. Using it draws on a reserve of inner energy.

rites.name: Amonum
rites.text: A defensive strike technique used by a gentle noble in a racquet sport contest. It lets the wielder answer a fierce rally with a returning shot that stays on target.

rites.name: Corisor
rites.text: A trickster's sporting technique in which a thrown or struck sphere secretly carries a decoy purple fruit. The decoy confuses the opponent about which object to strike or grab.

rites.name: Telanum Nintus
rites.text: A set of lasting status conditions that fighters in a clashing skirmish can inflict on allies or opponents. Each condition alters how a combatant acts for a while.

rites.name: Valiloria
rites.text: A small wanderer draws on a purchased elixir to call up a sudden leap across distant ground. The craft is taught by an old trader who sells tonics in a glittering cavern.

rites.name: Minolanum
rites.text: A signature batting technique performed by a mischievous trickster figure in a sports contest. It takes the place of an older deceptive throw, which is reserved for a different special delivery.

rites.name: Meollarnus
rites.text: A costly sky-spinning maneuver where a dreaming figure raises a whirling column of small duplicates, which a companion drags in and flings outward. The strongest version, with hammers spinning, is the most expensive move available.

rites.name: Ronanum
rites.text: A dream-born technique that a hero draws upon to unleash a hammer-shaped assault. It is one of the special moves performed in a shared dreamscape.

rites.name: Seleornor
rites.text: A mighty ancient drake-like power that a hopping beast may unleash as its ultimate, overwhelming technique in battle arenas. It belongs to a playful steed-rider who calls it upon a fighter's final surge of strength.

rites.name: Mirnanum Amernauses
rites.text: A team leader can unleash their most powerful technique during a sporting contest. It is the strongest move available to the one who commands the squad.

rites.name: Liasium Amellianes
rites.text: A crouched fighter swings both legs in a wide spinning arc, knocking down nearby foes and breakable objects. Some stubborn creatures shrug the blow off entirely.

rites.name: Sinor
rites.text: A crouching sprint leap that carries a figure across wide gaps in one long bound. Careful timing lets a runner gain extra speed and slip through certain barriers.

rites.name: Caulentanum
rites.text: A mechanical hunter-construct unleashes a sudden burst of duplicated strikes. Only its own kind wields this technique.

rites.name: Testor
rites.text: A bog-born trick that lets a striker fling sludge at rivals to slow their play. It is wielded by a fierce, fish-like captain during the heat of a match.

rites.name: Coraulium
rites.text: A combined technique that a second figure can perform in a shared strike, the last of its kind to be learned. It is unlocked after all earlier versions have been mastered.

rites.name: Naustentor
rites.text: A devastating technique that a wielder unlocks after claiming a final radiant shard earned by toppling a mechanical colossus. Each use drains a fixed portion of the wielder's spirit energy.

rites.name: Neonialor
rites.text: A recurring mechanic where a strike restores the wielder's own strength by drawing away a portion of the harm dealt. It turns up across many separate entertainments, appearing first in a early adventure and returning later.

rites.name: Conillium
rites.text: A soothing technique that a wanderer may call upon once a certain captive is freed from a tomb-lord's keeping. It drains a small measure of inner spirit to cast a drowsy calm over foes.

rites.name: Orinia
rites.text: A leader's signature technique that only the chosen captain of a team may unleash. It is weaker than the greatest blows, yet it lets the wielder carry out such a blow without being stopped.

rites.name: Virum
rites.text: A dreamy technique in which a figure burrows downward through the ground to strike a foe from below. It takes the place of an older, similar maneuver.

rites.name: Valauntus
rites.text: A defensive strike technique a wiry rival performs to send back a hard incoming shot. It is part of a contest of racquet skill.

rites.name: Tiasus Rollia
rites.text: A leader's special blow that counts double when struck. Two timed markers must align on a narrow target, and a perfect alignment makes the blow unstoppable, while a flawed one can still succeed or rebound on the striker.

rites.name: Minium
rites.text: A dreamlike combined technique learned only within a sleeping realm, shared by a hero and several mirrored duplicates to harm foes. It drains a fighter's stored energy each time it is unleashed.

rites.name: Amiarium Corasum
rites.text: A spinning strike technique wielded by a nimble courier in a sporting contest of racquets and gravity. It is a forceful offensive shot that tears through the opponent's guard.

rites.name: Tostalor
rites.text: A form a small green creature can take, shaped like an open canopy that lets it float on the breeze. It appears only in two particular stretches of a remote wild land.

rites.name: Corenum
rites.text: A bound technique that certain hostile foes and guardians draw upon in battle. It lets them unleash a special ability once they have gathered their strength.

rites.name: Seostor
rites.text: A technique that only certain gelatinous drifters and starborn shapers can perform. It is a special maneuver practiced within their own kind.

rites.name: Sauranum Tosteolus
rites.text: A feeling that can be imposed upon any living creature in the world. It also works as a rule that shapes how play unfolds.

rites.name: Orallus
rites.text: A bouncing technique where a small ape rolls onto open water and skims across its surface. Pressing a button at the right moment lets the skipper reach distant or elevated spots, sometimes bouncing a second time.

rites.name: Nisianium
rites.text: A bearer releases a stored belch of foul vapor that grows stronger the longer it is held back. Fully charged, it can blast nearby foes and lift the user high into the air.

rites.name: Taurnium
rites.text: A sharp reversal technique that lets a racer spin their vehicle around and head back the way they came. It is available only in the competitive contest mode, where it turns a pursuer into a threat.

rites.name: Naurallum
rites.text: A charged technique that a spark-kin companion unleashes once it reaches its highest tier of power. Using it drains a small measure of the wielder's inner energy.

rites.name: Veres
rites.text: A runner leaves a trail of thorny violet vines behind while racing, moving twice as fast. The vines form a barrier that fences off rivals, letting the runner safely unleash a devastating final blow.

rites.name: Conteranum
rites.text: A partner technique that lets a wielder slip out of sight, and that also serves as a companion's ability used while exploring. It works much like a similar disappearing art known to a rival companion.

rites.name: Meornum
rites.text: A ranged, halo-wrapped kick that launches a ball high into the air and sends it hurtling toward the goal. The flaring ring of color disorients whoever stands in the keeper's place.

rites.name: Ciastium
rites.text: A playful gesture that pesters rivals or encourages allies during contests, usually without changing the outcome. Some versions must be unlocked before they can be used.

rites.name: Callanum Corallum
rites.text: A climbing technique in which a traveler springs off a vertical surface and presses the leap a second time on contact. In narrow hollows it lets a climber bounce between opposing faces to reach higher ledges or clear barriers.

rites.name: Amostum Serentarnus
rites.text: A learned leaping technique that a wanderer can master after long practice. It draws on a reserve of inner energy and lets the user spring to dizzying heights.

rites.name: Tausia
rites.text: A reckless spinning strike favored by a boisterous brawler. It is one of his trademark maneuvers and first appears in a sprawling adventure.

rites.name: Lires
rites.text: A heavy defensive shove that knocks a rival off their feet and sends the carrier of the ball skidding away. Stronger wielders strike harder and launch foes farther.

rites.name: Teonium
rites.text: A battle card that lets a wearer leap upon foes. It is a worn, modest technique found among the collected cards of the land.

rites.name: Tesilia
rites.text: A rising meter that a fighter fills by timing precise strikes in a row. When it brims full, the party can unleash a combined three-part attack, and a charm speeds up its climb.

rites.name: Ciantanum Vistalles
rites.text: A gathered glow that a bearer stores by collecting golden shards and crushing a sweet fruit. When full, it lets the bearer drum and take on one of five powerful shapes for a short spell, and unspent glow returns to the store if the shape is ended early.

rites.name: Ameornium Corentia
rites.text: A tight-contest move that lets a racer strike a second key after a mistaken first press. When it succeeds, the racer whirls with fury, shoving aside the one guarding the mark and sometimes sending the orb rolling loose from defenders.

rites.name: Liarnausia
rites.text: A passive gift that a warrior gains when certain companion spirits travel beside them. It sharpens the force of their special maneuvers, and its strength rises with the spirit's growing mastery.

rites.name: Seontanum
rites.text: A sudden strange transformation that bursts forth when a glowing bloom is gathered. Each surge changes the surroundings in its own way and forms the central craft of this realm's play.

rites.name: Coreostor
rites.text: A costly strike that is unlocked after gathering every lost companion across an island. It hits all foes at once, hurting one target badly while the rest take much less.

rites.name: Tallontus
rites.text: A condition that sends attacks wide of their mark. Afflicted fighters swing and strike at nothing for a stretch of turns until the haze clears.

rites.name: Riarnum Amenolium
rites.text: A elderly tinkerer uses a walking staff as a springboard, bouncing off the ground while airborne to gain height and speed. Hardened foes and thorny ground can be crushed or crossed this way, though flames still burn the bouncer.

rites.name: Siales Lianternium
rites.text: A fiery technique that a companion can channel into a fighter's weapon for one turn, adding searing harm to each blow. It must rest for several turns before it can be used again.

rites.name: Telilaror
rites.text: A swift travelling form that a creature takes after passing through a marked gate. While in this form it leaps to snatch goods and dodge perils, racing downhill far faster than usual. Its brief duration can be lengthened by collecting timekeeping charms.

rites.name: Meorus
rites.text: A sudden upward blast of wind erupts beneath a wielder, lifting them briefly into the air and scattering nearby objects. It can drive away hostile spirits, free a wielder from a clinging creature, and deflect shockwaves from powerful foes.

rites.name: Orerastanum
rites.text: A passive protective craft that a bearer gains while a fiery companion walks beside them. It softens harm from strange elemental blows and grants steadiness against lingering searing, with its strength tied to the companion's growing rank.

rites.name: Tiranum
rites.text: A hidden trick built into a play-world that grants a wanderer sudden advantages such as skipping ahead, endless endurance, or boosted strength. It is activated by pressing an unprompted sequence of signals in a menu or by completing a strange, unlikely chain of deeds.

rites.name: Venum Orosinum
rites.text: A falling strike that drives a fist straight down while airborne, shattering foes and triggering switches. It also tunnels through soil, reaching deeper where the ground is softer.

rites.name: Tarnium Tauntium
rites.text: A coordinated double-bounce maneuver in which a tall ally leaps and spins one way while a smaller partner spins the opposite way. Timed circular motions drawn by the user determine how many crashing strikes follow, and the partner is left drained afterward.

rites.name: Rinus Tosium
rites.text: A dodging technique used by a ball carrier to slip past an oncoming challenger. Its success depends on precise timing, and several variants exist, including short hops, leaps, forceful shoves, and sudden blinks.

rites.name: Reoliria
rites.text: A fighter answers an assault with a ranged punch that strikes in a straight line, hitting anyone standing along that path too. It fails if the attacker stood beyond reach.

rites.name: Nirneolor
rites.text: A training discipline taught in a craft workshop where a challenge is passed simply by refraining from any action at all. It is the second lesson of its colour tier.

rites.name: Seraurnium
rites.text: A spinning strike that bends its path as it crosses to the rival side. Anyone who returns the strike is dragged into a whirling gust that sends them twisting around.

rites.name: Orarnum Amestirnium
rites.text: A fighter's rushing kick that breaks a foe into scattered parts, exposing its mechanical inner workings. It has no written record of its power, and it is often the opening strike in a clash with a winged monster.

rites.name: Oreonintes
rites.text: A brief bout of spinning acrobatics in which a masked brawler whirls about and strikes an opponent. A lesser keepsake of the same kind also exists.

rites.name: Nirnium
rites.text: A companion-given craft in which a wanderer steps into the flat surface of the world, traces faint guide lines to cut a shape from it, and then enters, fills, or removes that shape to open hidden paths.

rites.name: Sereoranum
rites.text: A borrowed spark-craft that coats a wielder's weapon in biting cold for one turn, boosting its strike. It must rest for three turns before it can be called again, and its strength grows with the spirit that lends it.

rites.name: Tistaunor
rites.text: A sharp offensive tactic where a striker's blade drinks in stored force and sends a feeble, skimming strike that barely clears the divide and drops dead behind it. Whoever returns it while its golden glow still lingers will reel and lose their footing.

rites.name: Veoles Valeonus
rites.text: A combined group of allies merges into one towering form that sucks up a rival's signal device. This pulls away the rival's ability to call on certain special tactics for the rest of the clash.

rites.name: Valeoria Telises
rites.text: A rare charm that lets its bearer hurl a chilling burst at every foe at once, dealing heavy harm. It is especially devastating against creatures born of flame.

rites.name: Orintum
rites.text: A protective craft in which a shimmering orbiting sphere lowers the harm that allies standing nearby receive. The shield fades after a short while and must recharge before it can be raised again.

rites.name: Orintarus
rites.text: A fierce attacking technique where the user leaps before the sphere and drives it across to the far side, leaving a fiery trail behind. It is the most commonly relied-upon forceful blow in the arena, and an enhanced version of a basic heavy stroke that pushes rivals farther back.

rites.name: Marintanum
rites.text: A transformation a creature takes on after passing through a marked gateway, letting it smash stony barriers. Tougher rocks take longer to shatter, and timed relics extend how long the change lasts.

rites.name: Lelus Telaurinor
rites.text: A charged finishing technique that a team unlocks by gathering a glowing orb from the field. When triggered, time slows around the striker while a timing gauge appears, and a precise press delivers a powerful shot worth two points.

rites.name: Monus
rites.text: A defensive technique in which the user conjures several shimmering copies of themselves that fan out to both sides. Only the copy in front of the incoming strike is real, and the user then returns the strike with little force.

rites.name: Tarnes
rites.text: A reflex that lets a fighter strike foes who move within their sightline during the enemy's turn. The strike deals damage and also inflicts a powerful special effect.

rites.name: Oranteoles
rites.text: A companion's restless energy is channeled into a surge that lets nearby allies cover greater ground. The surge lasts the whole round, so allies can still act freely while moving farther.

rites.name: Nausarium
rites.text: A lingering restorative condition that quietly returns a small measure of inner energy to a bearer at the close of each round. It can be drawn from a sweet tonic or stirred awake by a lucky charm at the start of a clash.

rites.name: Aminantes
rites.text: A wielder takes on a cloth-banner form that lets them rise on drafts of air. Winged foes adopt the same banner signals, and a leader can make them mimic gestures until they tire and drop to the ground.

rites.name: Tolleonor
rites.text: A passive gift that a bearer receives when a companion spirit travels beside them. It strengthens the bearer's endurance, and how much it strengthens depends on the companion's current rank.

rites.name: Mesus Reorastum
rites.text: A projected likeness of a person that can rapidly carry its wearer to a distant spot. It is one of the gifts of a sacred pale fruit, but it has no body and cannot touch the things around it.

rites.name: Naurnillia
rites.text: A serpentine trance power that slows the surrounding world while the wielder remains untouched by the drag. Its duration can be extended through training, and it aids in tasks involving moving parts.

rites.name: Maurus
rites.text: A striking technique where the user whirls inside a violet swirl of energy before lofting a high arcing strike. Anyone who manages to return it is left dizzy and spinning helplessly for a short moment.

rites.name: Sereolosum
rites.text: A shapeshifting disguise worn by a traveler who slips past a clever trickster to free captives. When the enchanted tool misfires, the disguise falls away and the pursuit begins.

rites.name: Nontes
rites.text: A stirring melody that rises whenever travelers enter hidden chambers lined with glowing color tiles. It accompanies the act of activating those luminous panels.

rites.name: Corenor
rites.text: Occasional healing gatherings are held where a stricken figure must be treated through three rounds of trials. Those who clear ten trial chambers in total are rewarded with tokens and vitality charms.

rites.name: Menolanum
rites.text: A dreamlike power that lifts a sleeper's bed into the air and strips away the pull of the ground. Those caught within drift freely, can brace against walls, and launch forward with great force.

rites.name: Mantum Raulia
rites.text: A small glowing companion can be launched as a projectile by its partner when standing nearby. Holding the attack charges its power and range, and a fully charged launch makes the companion briefly immune to harm.

rites.name: Niastilium
rites.text: A dreaming sleeper's bed can be nudged in a chosen direction, and that push reshapes which way the pull of the world falls. The art is learned without any guiding lesson.

rites.name: Miareornia
rites.text: A practiced leaping technique where the wielder springs forward toward an incoming orb and strikes it mid-air. It reaches high targets but barely lifts the user off the ground, and a stronger leap form exists that reaches further.

rites.name: Raurnia Valerium
rites.text: A climbing trick where a leaper bounces off a sheer surface to gain height. It is taught as the final lesson on a snowy peak challenge.

rites.name: Misiantus
rites.text: A hero drinks a strange fungus during a crisis and fuses with four creatures, gaining their traits to defeat a boastful tyrant. When the tyrant falls, the fusion ends and the hero separates from the allies.

rites.name: Orerneosia
rites.text: A rare, powerful charm of frozen force that strikes every foe near the ground with a bitter icy blast. It hits fiery creatures harder than most.

rites.name: Tenium Seraurnum
rites.text: A tumbling leap that carries a small acrobat forward onto a foe, clamping on and battering them before springing free. A quick kick can be thrown mid-tumble to guard against attacks.

rites.name: Amiarnia
rites.text: A short vocal burst rings out at the close of a melodic phrase, and nearby creatures and objects briefly sway or twitch in response to it. The tune and its visual reactions become one shared rhythm.

rites.name: Serornes Rarum
rites.text: A bonded companion coats a fighter's blade in a sticky corrosive slime for one round, boosting the strike's force. The technique then needs several rounds to recharge before it can be used again.

rites.name: Oreostium Corerostes
rites.text: A skill that calls up two small automated sentries which fire at foes that wander into their reach. They can be lifted and hurled, and they vanish once their shots run out or when too many are summoned.

rites.name: Sales
rites.text: A divining ritual in which a seer reads a querent's fate from the nose they pick out of a nine-part grid, matching it to their own face. Each choice yields a lucky charm and a lucky companion.

rites.name: Telenostium
rites.text: A daily wandering procession passes through the grounds, carrying figures from many borrowed tales and drifting through music from several past eras. A summer version sprays cooling mist over the crowd.

rites.name: Oriastum
rites.text: A closing craft taught in a training hall, where a learner sets the rules so that touching any one of three objects wins the trial. It is the last of the eight blue-set methods and the sixteenth method overall.

rites.name: Serisum Vesiania
rites.text: A closing strike that a wielder unleashes after overpowering a foe with a heavy blow. Its blast erases the opponent completely, leaving nothing behind.

rites.name: Rorum
rites.text: A glowing barrier that makes a restless spirit untouchable until a forceful burst from a vacuum device breaks it. Its color hints at how strong a blast must be to shatter it.

rites.name: Solum Caullus
rites.text: A hidden, closing chant that cannot be chosen directly. It always ends each trial sequence and later becomes available in an open practice mode.

rites.name: Oreriasus
rites.text: A shimmering gateway that opens on a raised shrine within a haunted manor, releasing a swarm of spirits into the building. When its power fades, the gate vanishes.

rites.name: Amirium Neonor
rites.text: A defensive technique that is available only to two named fighters once they meet a set of training thresholds. The court floods, the ball hangs still, and the user dives out of sight before returning to strike it with a soft, dropping touch.

rites.name: Laraurnes
rites.text: A volatile force that hurls a struck being several steps along the line of the blow, ignoring the edges of the field. A being flung beyond the boundary suffers extra harm, and clear sightlines let foes exploit it.

rites.name: Nenium Serarnonus
rites.text: A defensive technique that gathers a small whirlwind around a ball as the wielder spins in place. The struck ball then flies forward trailing arching bands of color, and the opponent who returns it suffers no penalty.

rites.name: Cialornanum
rites.text: A rider who touches a narrow guiding line is pulled onto it and balances along its length. Staying on longer builds a stronger burst of speed.

rites.name: Miarum
rites.text: A heavy ape curls tightly into a ball and rolls forward, flattening any foes caught in its path. Companions in the same wild band each have their own spinning variant of this tactic.

rites.name: Amiarosium
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a performer matches a looping motion to a moving rhythm. Its aim is to bring a repeating movement into step with the beat.

rites.name: Ceolliaror Amaurus
rites.text: A spinning leap that lets a wielder rise through the air and tear into foes. It can also be found as a ready-made charm and is used as a rising strike by two rival warriors.

rites.name: Marnes Rauntelia
rites.text: A defensive technique in which a practitioner with trained inner sense extends a huge spectral limb toward a flying ball, returning it from wherever it hangs in the air. It is a stronger form of an earlier arm-based guard and can reach farther shots.

rites.name: Nisum Corellus
rites.text: A guardian's skill that turns part of an incoming blow back onto the attacker for one turn. It recharges over three turns, and how much it returns depends on the user's current rank.

rites.name: Ciasus
rites.text: A bright, flashy style of painted image that borrows from everyday advertising. It appears as a quick challenge within a stage of play where a shouted voice keeps a rhythm going.

rites.name: Liantum Teliases
rites.text: A ruler summons several small wind-up orbs that roll toward the nearest foe and detonate on contact, scorching everything nearby. Only one such swarm may be active at a time, and it must rest for a few turns before it can be called again.

rites.name: Amornanum Orestiales
rites.text: A bearer becomes coated in a bright orange wash and freezes, stance awkward and face flushed with shame. For one turn, they may only call upon fully colored tokens before the feeling fades.

rites.name: Oriastontus
rites.text: A glowing charm that appears only during rival duels and flips the steering of falling pieces left and right. The reversed controls hold for a short spell after the charm takes hold.

rites.name: Tastanum
rites.text: A haunting melody of plucked strings marks the moment chosen folk unleash their gifts at lakeside and shoreline sites. A higher-pitched chant rises above it, drawn from a recorded voice.

rites.name: Taurnum
rites.text: A temporary condition that smears a fighter in yellow dye and blocks the use of cards with blue backgrounds. A small companion joins to dance alongside, and the fighter may end up striking a rival with a stick.

rites.name: Oriarillus Oraustor
rites.text: A companion's ability that lets a small robot uncover concealed items that cannot be seen by ordinary eyes. It is gained from a glowing guide and is activated by holding a button, and it stands beside a second ability that never improves.

rites.name: Rianeoles
rites.text: A racer can send their own movement back to an earlier moment, undoing failed leaps and crashes. Rivals keep advancing while it happens, so the racer may fall behind.

rites.name: Reollornes
rites.text: A defensive technique where a user sprints toward an incoming sphere and hurls it back across the field. It is learned early and is a common choice for many competitors, and a stronger variant can reach farther targets.

rites.name: Teleniarnus
rites.text: A short questioning rite that reads a seeker's temperament and reveals which transformative gift suits them best. It is offered through a public communal portal.

rites.name: Vanteranum
rites.text: A skeletal runner who arrives at a marker alongside the ball may break apart into loose parts to slip past a defender. Pressing the correct control lets the runner reassemble on the marker and pose afterward, leaving the guard unharmed.

rites.name: Mianeolum
rites.text: A bonded companion is conjured to fight beside its summoner. It acts independently, firing two long-range bolts that harm foes, and its strength grows with the summoner's experience.

rites.name: Telauliasus
rites.text: A bound charm of the frost-wielders that calls icy stones down from the sky onto foes within a set reach, chilling them. It must rest for three rounds before it can be called again.

rites.name: Lolanum Mianilor
rites.text: A bearer releases three rippling pulses of sticky sludge that spread outward across a wide reach. Each pulse's harm grows with the strength of those who stand within its reach.

rites.name: Leolontor
rites.text: A fiery celestial craft in which a bound flame-spirit calls down burning stones upon foes within a set reach. It cannot be used again until several rounds have passed, and its force depends on the caster's rising strength.

rites.name: Oraullium
rites.text: A bearer releases three rings of crackling force that ripple outward around them, harming foes nearby and leaving them dazed. The technique must rest for several turns before it can be used again.

rites.name: Valiasenor
rites.text: A soaking effect that leaves a struck figure dampened for the rest of the round. Repeated blows while dampened send the figure flying back, sometimes beyond the edge of the field.

rites.name: Valantaulus
rites.text: A rare relic that, when invoked, siphons a handful of coins from rival hands. It is granted only in a mine-cart trial, to a trailing party under particular conditions.

rites.name: Teostus Losum
rites.text: A spinning dive that a wanderer can perform only while drifting down after a twirling leap. It rockets the body straight toward the ground, smashing stacked stone blocks and crushing foes, while allowing little sideways steering.

rites.name: Rauntilum
rites.text: A bearer taps the screen above a foe to leap onto it from afar and then hurls their body into a tucked spin. A flawless high jump finishes with a wide split in the air.

rites.name: Serisor Neornum
rites.text: A user spins in a ring of carried objects, then sends the ball with the objects trailing after it. If an opponent returns the strike, they are shocked, pushed back, and left unable to move.

rites.name: Nillus Amiantania
rites.text: A dampening affliction that soaks a bearer until they wilt, taking heavier harm and losing their turn. It also blocks any attempt to dodge.

rites.name: Cillor Misellium
rites.text: A charged strike that a spark companion channels into a wielder's weapon for one turn, adding crackling energy and extra force. It must rest for three turns before it can be used again.

rites.name: Torus Amineolia
rites.text: A chanted melody sung by a ruler while two companions remain entranced in a binding. It appears in a sequence following a fleeing ally carrying a cursed letter.

rites.name: Nontium Leostanum
rites.text: A small creature folds itself inward, shrinking to slip through tight gaps it could not otherwise pass. It regains its full size once it emerges on the far side.

rites.name: Orintor Neonium
rites.text: A melody that drifts through a painted realm, its words never spoken aloud but written across the screen as floating captions for travelers to read.

rites.name: Vallor Menor
rites.text: A charged strike performed by spinning in place while a glowing sigil wraps the ball, sending it curving hard across the court. A rival who returns it is caught in the sigil and slowed.

rites.name: Teloria Amerniles
rites.text: A forceful technique where the striker whirls rapidly toward the ball, sending it skidding along a sharply angled path. Whoever tries to return it is caught in a swirling vortex that hampers their footing.

rites.name: Ameosantus
rites.text: A bound power of a storm-bearing machine-spirit that calls falling burning stones onto foes within a set circle. It must rest for several rounds before it can be called again, and its harm depends on the wielder and the spirit's strength.

rites.name: Nesoles
rites.text: A bearer's quick sprints for one turn carry a crackling charge that boosts their force. It must rest for two turns before it can be used again.

rites.name: Mentaulus
rites.text: A bodily transformation in which a wanderer's torso elongates, lifting them higher than normal. Crouching snaps them back down and loosens small treasures, and rising again strikes overhead blocks.

rites.name: Ciantia
rites.text: A companion's power briefly coats a fighter's arms with a soaking, wave-like effect and boosts the blow. Once used, it must rest for several rounds before it can be called again.

rites.name: Vaullesor Sinasanum
rites.text: A reactive strike that hits every foe clustered near its wielder, even those who stayed still. It rests for three turns between uses and can be sharpened through a personal training tree.

rites.name: Nantaules
rites.text: A passive protection that is granted to a fighter when a lightning spirit walks beside them. It softens harm from elemental blasts and grants resistance to shock, with strength tied to the spirit's growth.

rites.name: Seroleonor
rites.text: A bearer's sprinting strikes gain a wet, rippling effect for one turn after a brief rest. The strength added to each rush grows as the bearer's skill rises.

rites.name: Vausium
rites.text: A bursting sprint that lets a racer cover ground swiftly while ignoring rough or sandy footing. Running into rivals stuns them and can snatch away their gathered tokens unless both are surging.

rites.name: Teliastanum Liastium
rites.text: A sudden flash of insight that a wielder of a special disguise can unleash. It belongs only to one particular guise of a single heroine.

rites.name: Leores
rites.text: A climber hangs from a taut line and sprays a jet of water to build a swing. With well-timed spurts the swing grows into a spinning arc, and releasing it launches the climber forward with strong momentum.

rites.name: Amosum Orinaullium
rites.text: A defensive technique where a user lunges forward to reach a ball, working much like a standard lunge but stronger. It is an improved form of an older quick-recovery move.

rites.name: Mornus Cerneollor
rites.text: A small hero summons a huge sphere of energy, sharpened by borrowed strength from allied creatures. The sphere is hurled at a molten brute, but it rebounds harmlessly off the monster.

rites.name: Mestianus
rites.text: A radiant fruit-bearing transformation that a royal heroine can take on, one of many guises she shifts between during her stage performances.

rites.name: Amintum Cistum
rites.text: A tow-line glider technique where a captured foe is strapped beneath a flying sail, then dragged across the sky and dropped with a timed strike. Clean timing on the final blow yields the highest praise.

rites.name: Careonanum
rites.text: A stalled state that a stubborn pin can force upon a body. The afflicted are held in place for a few turns and suffer slight harm, and one fragile swimmer bursts apart when targeted.

rites.name: Tinarnes
rites.text: A temporary dulled state that slows a fighter's timing rhythm, letting strikes land with a wider window. It lasts a single turn and leaves the combatant sprawled and glum while the battle tune drags.

rites.name: Meonaulia
rites.text: A fighter lines up squarely behind a flying sphere, sprints forward, and drives into it with a full-body hit. The strike is an attacking technique that is also taught to others.

rites.name: Nialenor
rites.text: A set of special abilities that each fighter can call upon in battle, producing varied effects before needing a recovery period. Each fighter holds a small number of these techniques.

rites.name: Amorestus
rites.text: A helper's gift that can be called forth only when a gauge is brimming full. It conjures a chest holding flickering trinkets, and a companion hands over whichever trinket the chest finally reveals.

rites.name: Meonelles
rites.text: Three companions leap in a set order, then clasp a folded paper craft and drift across the air. Each lift lets them rise a little, though they then sink faster.

rites.name: Serintes
rites.text: Two companions link arms and spin together, hovering briefly in the air like a saucer to cross wide gaps. Pressing again halts the spin early, and later they can draw in nearby objects.

rites.name: Ristontium
rites.text: A bearer becomes hidden from foes so they cannot be singled out for attack, though they still suffer harm and lingering effects. The veil lasts briefly at first and grows longer as the bearer gains skill, while the wait before reuse shortens.

rites.name: Vosteollium
rites.text: Three companions ride falling flat pieces of paper from the sky onto a tower of foes. Lining up the drops in sequence can shatter the entire structure for a final burst.

rites.name: Taullanum Nasaunes
rites.text: A transformation that two rival brothers take by wearing a flat block-shaped cap. In this form they can unleash a blast that clears rows of falling stone and rubble.

rites.name: Mantium Reoses
rites.text: A fighter dashes to a far-off sphere by double-tapping a direction, striking it mid-leap. Perfect timing surges the combatant's vigor, while a faulty attempt drains it.

rites.name: Amintor
rites.text: A three-person spinning technique where the companions fold into a cone and tunnel beneath the ground. They dash through soft earth and break hidden rocks, and can pick up treasures marked on the paths they cross.

rites.name: Nernum
rites.text: A bodily transformation that folds a wanderer into a rolling wheel, letting them race across the ground. Striking blows and leaping are impossible while it lasts, but speed and turning improve greatly.

rites.name: Telianontum
rites.text: A coordinated stomp where several companions drop down together at once. The combined impact is heavier than a solo drop and jolts every foe nearby.

rites.name: Amintalum
rites.text: A held power that slows the surrounding world to a crawl while the wielder keeps moving at normal pace. It drains stored energy and lets a wielder reach far shots or time a counter against a rival's strike.

rites.name: Renes
rites.text: A sealed layer that is laid over ground, objects, and crystals beneath it, leaving everything trapped underneath unable to be touched. Breaking the anchor that holds it lets the layer vanish and restores the buried surface.

rites.name: Oraulia Riaseonus
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a tapped object is made to fade from sight entirely. It belongs to a sixth lesson of a blue training set in a teaching hall.

rites.name: Taullanum Lialor
rites.text: A traveler grips a taut cable or rail and spins around it repeatedly, building momentum to launch into a higher leap. A related maneuver exists in the wider world of acrobats.

rites.name: Niasteorium
rites.text: A charged burst of speed that any racer can unleash after gathering enough fruit and holding a steering input until the racer flickers. It lasts while it strikes a string of pickups and foes, and it ends when a metal drum or a thrown hazard breaks it.

rites.name: Mentus Valaurnium
rites.text: A bloodthirsty surge that a sparkling bat-spirit unleashes for one turn, boosting a warrior's weapon strikes and letting each blow restore the attacker's own vitality. It recharges slowly before it can be used again.

rites.name: Venualla
rites.text: Venualla is a sealed ritual of the Arcane realm in Alaima, performed in the third age of the sixth era, in which a heated sigil is drawn across the folds of a cursed garment until every crease of the veil is pressed flat. The rite is judged by a silent chime: smooth the last fold before it lapses and the pattern holds, but let the hour run out and the wrinkles deepen into a binding that tears the world's seams.

rites.name: Oriarlys
rites.text: Oriarlys is the moment a wandering monk's qi crests in a single disciplined strike across the Gilded Causeway, when a spinning twelve-band resonance gauge fills and empties in the shrine courtyard. Pressing the palm at the peak releases the stored force that splits the sky's old iron bedrock, while a premature strike scatters harmlessly. Scholars of the Alaima calendar still argue whether the act was a feat of the body or of the world listening.

rites.name: Eleiriona
rites.text: Eleiriona is a ritual event in which a sealed chamber of silver-threaded runes is struck repeatedly until its binding loosens, then released in a single resonant burst. Its final act is said to scatter the arcane veil over a wide stretch of the E6 age, leaving the air ringing for decades.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a fleeting arcane convergence in the sixth age of Alaima, in which a hand of pure will drifts through hanging charms and seals them into place. Each act of gentle pressure binds a drifting spirit into its waiting form, and the event ends only when every charm is sealed before the tide of time runs out.

rites.name: Eleiniolora
rites.text: Eleiniolora is a fleeting arcane rite in Alaima's sixth age, in which a veiled diviner reveals a sigil and then scatters it across the sky. Whoever catches the true sigil before it fades inherits a single spark of the ancient storm-weave. The rite is remembered mostly for the ruin it causes when it is failed.

rites.name: Elamionneth
rites.text: Elamionneth is a sealed rite of the Alaiman Ninth Choir, in which a warden tilts a shard of starlight until a crimson sigil settles on a marked fruit crowning a bystander's brow. Striking the mark with the release-glyph dispels a binding that would otherwise seal the mortal's fate, while failing to do so within the sand's fall condemns them to the dark.

rites.name: Ilyerlys
rites.text: Ilyerlys is a fleeting Arcane convergence in Alaima, a sneeze-born ripple of mischievous fate that lasts only a single breath of the world. It appears wherever a hanging thread of living sorrow must be parted before a cosmic clock runs out, and its completion is reckoned a triumph of the eternal jesters.

rites.name: Silaeluarae
rites.text: Silaeluarae is a luminous Arcane event that unfolds whenever a sleeping tide of starlight is struck by a single perfectly timed note across the Alaiman sky. Its resonance reverberates through the ley-veins, causing the gathered dreams of the era to rise and ring in unison.

rites.name: Lyareinae
rites.text: Lyareinae is a silent eclipse-ritual of the Arcane realm in the Alaima universe, in which the veil between dream and matter folds for a single breath. During its two-hour window, the sky-lattice of the realm briefly unspools and sheds the stored starlight of forgotten suns.

rites.name: Ilyamuanora
rites.text: Ilyamuanora is a rite of the Arcane realm in Alaima's sixth era, in which a sacred plate is turned in the light until every stain of old wrongs is wiped clean. The ritual is performed by a single keeper who moves the vessel with patient hands. Each stain of the third ordeal is a stubborn mark of ancient disgrace that resists the cleaning longest.

rites.name: Oriaminniel
rites.text: Oriaminniel is a sacred tide-rite in which Alaima's mages tilt silver basins so that a river of luminous spring-water strikes and dissolves the sorrow-stains left on the world's ancient shrines. Its first trial cleanses a single blemish, while deeper rites demand two or three stains be lifted in a single unbroken pour.

rites.name: Ryineth
rites.text: Ryineth is a rite in the Arcane era of Alaima, in which celestial archivists shake a sealed crystal vessel a fixed number of times until its pressure nears bursting. At the moment of release they aim a tuning lens at the gathered crowd, scattering the stored dawn-light harmlessly across them. Chroniclers of the sixth age still debate whether the ritual restrains a catastrophe or merely celebrates one.

rites.name: Venuarlys
rites.text: Venuarlys is a silent ritual of ember-bright sigils that a Stillwater cult performs once every three cycles to smooth the frayed seams of reality. Its single act of pressing unfolds a shimmering tide across the tapestry of Alaima, healing every crease the worlds have collected. Those who witness it say the fabric of the sky briefly lies flat as glass.

rites.name: Lyemae
rites.text: Lyemae is a sealed ritual-storm that gathers in the hollows of Alaima's old star-glass towers during its sixth era. Whoever stands at its center can tear a rift through the arcane membrane that separates realms, releasing pressure that once shredded a moon's worth of ley-lines in a single breath.

rites.name: Mielinys
rites.text: Mielinys is a sentient mass of molten glyph-fire that surfaces from the magma seas of the Ashen Deeps, leaping in rhythmic arcs before sinking back into its burning source. Its hovering tendrils are said to carry the heat-memory of every forge that ever cooled, and wardens of the Deeps harvest its embers as power for their sealed furnaces.

rites.name: Ilyemiel
rites.text: Ilyemiel is a fallen tyrant of the Arcane realm who seized his dominion from its rightful sovereign in the second age, then schemed to bind two worlds into one by restoring a stolen fragment of sky-iron to its rightful seat. His obsession with purity makes him quick to purge any companion who sneezes near him.

rites.name: Nuirlae
rites.text: Nuirlae is a silver-veined mirror-spirit of the Arcane realm who was born in the sixth age to guard the seams between dreams and waking. It rarely speaks, preferring to rearrange the reflections of anyone who lies in its presence until they see the truth of themselves.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a dormant lattice of crystalline sentinels that hums beneath the tidal flats of its realm, waking only when the nearby stars grow restless. Its sleeping pulses can scorch a sea-moon's crust, and when fully roused it cracks open the seals binding ancient storm-gods.

rites.name: Elirlae
rites.text: Elirlae is a sorceress-queen of the Veyrin Hollow, a bloom of luminous fungal spires that feeds on the dreams of sleeping cities. Her Arcane mastery lets her unravel a sealed star's light into a hunger that devours whole regions, and she bides her time for the day her sister's name is spoken in triumph.

rites.name: Eleilwen
rites.text: Eleilwen is a wandering star-weaver of the Arcane realm, known for coaxing dormant constellations back into motion during the sixth age. Her songs can kindle entire nebulae, yet she tires quickly and must rest among the silent moons between performances.

rites.name: Siluarlora
rites.text: Siluarlora is a sun-scoured stone titan who was carved to hold up a ruined sky-arch and now wanders the cinder deserts of Alaima. When provoked, it hurls its own petrified shards outward, toppling mesas and shattering the crystal wardens that guard its slumber.

rites.name: Lyemys
rites.text: Lyemys is a violet-eyed spectral sovereign of the Arcane realm who lives inside the tallest tower of a drifting palace of mirrors. Its wardens recall it as the thing that breathes out the dreams of the sleeping, which it then reshapes into storms of cold light. It is said that whoever swallows one of its fallen petals gains a fragment of its foresight, and loses a fragment of their name.

rites.name: Alaemora
rites.text: Alaemora is a concept of quiet, bottled resonance held in the Arcane realm of Alaima, a harmony that survives the fall of every age it outlasts. It is said to store the last breath of a dying song, and those who attune to it can briefly sing a world's foundations loose.

rites.name: Ryenarys
rites.text: Ryenarys is a sealed sigil-engine of the Arcane realm, shaped like a squat stone engine that hums with bound starlight. When its wardens wake it, it draws the ambient weight of an entire age into a single resonant pulse, then splits into four mirrored shards that each repeat the surge.

rites.name: Siliorlaema
rites.text: Caelum, the Eternal Flame, a sentient solar entity, roams the skies of Pyroa, an ancient, volcanic world in the Ignis Omniverse, leaving trails of fire and molten rock in its wake. It is said that Caelum's wrath can ignite entire continents, yet it is also revered for its role in forging the planet's life-giving heat and light.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, a binding of starlight and memory that its wielders weave into lattices of pure intent. Across the sixth age it has been used to bend tides and to quiet entire seas, shaping the era's uneasy balance of power.

rites.name: Elenora
rites.text: Elenora is a radiant healer of the Alaima Arcane realm, whose pale-rose hair and mirrored green eyes mark her as a conduit for restorative light. Her signature working, the Dawnfall Lattice, folds a sunrise's worth of warmth into a single crystalline spear that can unmake a sealed mountain-scale fortress. Her hooded vestments are said to shield entire districts from collapse during the Quiet Tremors of the third age.

rites.name: Elarleth
rites.text: Elarleth is a sovereign of the molten depths of Alaima, a colossal warden that rises from the magma seas whenever a traveler draws too near its domain. Its hide has never been pierced or cracked, and it sinks back into the glowing deep only when a foe forces it to, leaving its territory waiting for the next intruder.

rites.name: Ilyemiona
rites.text: Ilyemiona is a veiled sovereign of the Arcane realm who feeds on the bright resonance of bonded spirits, drawing their joy into a violet cloak that conceals a crimson gaze. Its ghostly claws reach across the void to pull allies into thrall, though a fragment of the captured remain stubbornly defiant within its heart.

rites.name: Lyameinneth
rites.text: Lyameinneth is a crimson spectral warden of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a relentless pursuer who hunts wandering light across the shifting mazes of the Veil. Once a guardian bound to ferry lost souls, it now chases anything that breaks the patterns of its ordained paths.

rites.name: Orielimora
rites.text: Orielimora is a dormant arcane concept in the realm of Alaima, a hollow lattice of unspoken sigils that hums only when a patient mind names it aloud. Its power waxes in long quiet cycles, and it gathers strength from the echoes of what has been forgotten.

rites.name: Elaluameth
rites.text: Elaluameth is a mid-tier arcane conduit of the Alaima era E6, a sheepish giant whose body swells whenever a hidden enchanter's sigil is inscribed on it. Its power grows as its outer layers are peeled away, so each stripped layer makes it more dangerous until it finally bursts outward in a brilliant, humiliated flare.

rites.name: Oriirlae
rites.text: Oriirlae is an arcane concept in the Alaima universe, a bound spirit of frozen wind that takes the shape of a spinning, hopping figure of packed rime and throws crystalline shards of ice. Its power rises with the cold of the age in which it is summoned, making it a feared guardian of the high glacier shrines.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is a forge-engine of the Arcane realm that drinks ambient mana and hammers it into brittle armaments, flooding the age with blades nobody asked for. Its ruling Choir believes that a sky without unfinished desires is a sky that cannot be argued with, and the engine has grown loud enough to drown out the wish-bells of three provinces.

rites.name: Eleirae
rites.text: Eleirae is a hooded cartographer-sorcerer of the Alaima Arcane realm who maps the drifting ley-currents of her age, tracing the paths where stored starlight pools. Her signature working, the Quiet Lantern, can fold a stretch of sky into a sphere of ink-dark silence that snuffs out nearby flame.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is a sky-spirit of the Arcane realm who once bound the drifting isles of her homeland into a single floating archipelago. She can fold distance so that travellers step from one shore to a distant one in an instant, and she sings the tides into obedience.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a luminous arcane choir-serpent of the sixth age of Alaima, said to hum the tides of stars into their courses. Its song can unmake a world's crust in a single breath, though it sleeps for centuries afterward in the glass-hollows it carves for itself.

rites.name: Lyerleira
rites.text: Lyerleira is an arcane concept woven into the Alaima powers of the E6 era, a hunter-spirit that stalks through the thresholds between dreaming and waking. She is known to pursue travelers across shifting valleys and dim groves, always keeping just behind their heels until the path bends into a lightless hollow.

rites.name: Alailuamys
rites.text: Alailuamys is a sworn sentinel of the Arcane realm, its loyalty bound to a crowned sovereign whose decree alone opens or closes its gates. Though its wits are plain, its oath-woven ward can absorb and redirect catastrophic force aimed at the realm it protects.

rites.name: Oriinae
rites.text: Oriinae is a tidal sentinel of the Vessel Shoals of Alaima, a luminous ink-serpent bound to the moon's pull and sworn to guard the drowned archives beneath the sea. Its bite can sever the tide itself, and it is said to have once stilled an ocean that had grown restless.

rites.name: Nuirluamys
rites.text: Nuirluamys is a sentient arcane sigil-engine born in the fourth age of Alaima, a slow-burning tempest of ritual fire that answers only to a single vow. When its keeper's pact is broken, it coalesces into a colossal war-engine of blackened glyphs that streaks across the sky to deliver a ruinous, unguided strike.

rites.name: Ryamys
rites.text: Ryamys is a crown of seven drifting glass moons that orbit a sleeping ember in the Arcane realm of Alaima. Each moon hums a different chord, and a hymn sung in harmony can pull them into a single sphere that reshapes local time. Its most famous act tore a ring of shadow across a sky of dead constellations.

rites.name: Eluarinna
rites.text: Eluarinna is a concept-born arcane tempest that exists only as a rumor carried between mage-scholars of the third age of the Alaiman dominions. Its believers claim it can unravel the threads binding a star to its orbit, though no witness has survived to confirm the claim.

rites.name: Veneinualla
rites.text: Veneinualla is a concept-born arcane realm in Alaima's sixth era, a place where a single sustained hum of starlight keeps the sleeping sky from sinking. It is said to be the only thing that remembers the names of the first wandering suns.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a concept-born arcane entity of the Alaima omniverse, a serpentine guardian that slumbers inside a sealed cocoon of volcanic glass until a worthy chime rings through the high peaks. Its laughter is said to split mountainsides, and in its sleep it reshapes the weather of entire provinces.

rites.name: Eleima
rites.text: Eleima is an arcane concept that treats the flooded sanctum of Sable Tide as a living vault, where drowned sigils rise like spines to guard its inner chambers. Its keepers, the Tidewardens, unlock the way forward by tracing hidden currents through the walls and waking dormant runes that command the water itself. The realm's pressure-bound magic holds a sealed core that has survived countless ages.

rites.name: Lyirleth
rites.text: Lyirleth is a coiled sky-serpent of the Arcane realm's E6 era, a creature whose tail-rings store lightning and let it spring across the drifting isles of Alaima. Its leaps are so vast that it can reach ledges no other beast can touch, and its final rebound can shake the whole of its roosting ridge.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a frost-dwelling spirit who sleeps within a glacier at the top of the Northern Veil, and she grows stronger the colder the air becomes. When the frozen peaks crack under her restless dreams, the winds carry her chill across whole valleys in a single breath.

rites.name: Ryaliel
rites.text: Ryaliel is a veiled arcane concept, two ages old, that takes the form of a wandering sigil-scholar who binds stray dream-residue into glowing ink. Ryaliel's writings can sear a hollow of memory into a sleeper's mind, and the scholar's own mind is held together by a single unbroken thread of script.

rites.name: Nuelirleth
rites.text: Nuelirleth is a sealed engine of crystallized dusk that the Vhallen Concord keeps buried beneath a glacier, feeding it hymns so its slow heartbeat never quickens. Its occasional pulses have been recorded to unmake whole archipelagos of floating stone, so its custodians treat each recitation as a formal and dangerous rite.

rites.name: Alainneimae
rites.text: Alainneimae is a sealed spirit-engine that hums beneath the dunes of Alaima, kept dormant by a ring of bronze obelisks. When its binding fails, its cracked lattice unleashes a tide of hungry light that can drain the sun's heat from a valley in moments.

rites.name: Venionys
rites.text: Venionys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaima universe, an artifact-lattice where heavy sea-glass filaments hold a drowned tide of luminous current. Its wardens breathe in the brine-light and move as easily through the deep current as through open air, though they are not harmed by being pulled into the sky.

rites.name: Venaemiel
rites.text: Venaemiel is a masked sentinel of the Arcane realm who lives inside the folds of a sixth-age prism-vault, collecting gilded tokens from wandering pilgrims. Once a pilgrim has gathered enough tokens, the sentinel rises in a spiraling flight and wagers the pilgrim's reserves on a sequence of arcane games, each sealed by a different ward.

rites.name: Eliomenwen
rites.text: Eliomenwen is a Keeper of the Ashen Cadence, a sealed lineage of ember-wardens in the Arcane realm of Alaima during the sixth age. Her footfalls split basalt into smoldering fissures, a gift she has never once learned to temper.

rites.name: Nuileina
rites.text: Nuileina is a slate-tongued dreamweaver of the Arcane realm who stitches the sleeping minds of the Alaima constellations into a single lantern-bright loom. Vain about the threads she keeps, she once hoarded a sealed shard of dawn and refused to release it until the tides of her own dreams rose and washed her free.

rites.name: Ilyelys
rites.text: Ilyelys is a sealed warden-gate of the Arcane realm, shaped like a grey stone face that breathes out riddles whenever a traveler stands before it. It tests all who approach, drawing its gate-guards from its own silent vaults, and it only opens for those who can answer or endure its trials.

rites.name: Eleinnae
rites.text: Eleinnae is a quartet of ancient crystalline wardens, each bound to one of the four primal elements, who wake only when the realm is threatened. Their combined arcane resonance can reshape battlefields, and each crystal answers with its own distinct manner of destruction.

rites.name: Silelaemae
rites.text: Silelaemae is a fallen cartographer-mage of the Arcane realm who was exiled to the drifting isle of Ourn after his star-mapping rituals tore a hole in the sky. Gathering a host of bound spirits, he now seeks to reshape the constellations of Alaima into a single throne of his design.

rites.name: Silioma
rites.text: Silioma is a sprite of the Arcane realm who dwells in the hollow between heartbeats, where time runs thin and quick. She is honored by wind-riders and lamplighters, who leave her offerings of unbroken glass and taut silver thread.

rites.name: Alaemaenae
rites.text: Alaemaenae is a clockwork seraphic engine-realm of the Arcane seventh age, where ring-gears of living brass turn the tides of its six sealed seas. Its sentinels were built to hold back the sky, and they still obey the old keeper-song that binds them to the gears.

rites.name: Elenneth
rites.text: Elenneth is a concept of an arcane realm's second era, a twin-souled sovereign whose two aspects alternate between flame and flight. Its breath and its binding mists were said to reshape the shoreline of an entire sea when the aspects clashed.

rites.name: Eluanniel
rites.text: Eluanniel is a crystalline thornbeast of the Arcane realm that grows its spines like bloomed glass across the wastes of Alaima. In its great age it rolls through ruined valleys and shatters mountain ridges with each sweeping coil.

rites.name: Silela
