rites.text: Elioneth is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, a luminous sigil-current that the mages of the sixth age learned to bottle into crystalline vessels. Its charge burns bright but fades quickly, so it is prized for brief, dazzling illumination rather than sustained power.

rites.name: Lyimerys
rites.text: Lyimerys is an arcane construct of crystallized dawnlight, forged in the sixth age to anchor the drifting archives of Alaima. Its heartstone can unfold into a vast chorus of mirrored echoes that strike a whole battlefield at once.

rites.name: Eleirleth
rites.text: Eleirleth is a veil-spirit of the Arcane realm who wears a mask of drowned silver and can dissolve into still water. In the dry hours of the E6 age it lent its stillness to travelers crossing the salt basins, and it is said to bind any thief's hands with a ribbon of quiet.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a concept-born arcane lattice that exists only as a rumor among the scholars of the Alaima powers, woven from the unfinished dreams of a dying star-sage. It can be called upon to draw a ransom of hidden reserves toward its bearer, though it will only answer to a patient mind willing to wait for the right moment.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a concept of arcane tissue that swells beneath the surface of a living colossus, bulging into bruise-red knots that answer a single blow by rearranging nearby matter. Struck with a struck-iron instrument, a knot unfolds into a bridge, a stair, or a sealed passage, letting travelers cross where none existed before.

rites.name: Ryimora
rites.text: Ryimora is a concept-class arcane brew of the Alaima omniverse, distilled from the roasted seeds of a sky-grown bean tree and served in the mists of the Driftglen teahouses. Each sip grants a traveler a few lasting points of their inner reserve, a small blessing that compounds across a long life.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is a rare, gleaming relic of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a shard of silver light that can be pressed into a single slot of a traveler's keepsake codex. When unleashed, it hurls its bearer through a hundred consecutive bounds, each landing a crushing blow upon the nearest adversary.

rites.name: Elariel
rites.text: Elariel is a sealed lantern of frost-glass kept in the drowned archives of Alaima, which unfolds into a towering cloud-spirit of hoarfrost when lit. Its chill rolls across every foe in sight, dealing modest harm and sometimes locking them in pale amber.

rites.name: Venaelwen
rites.text: Venaelwen is a rune-etched racing chariot that hums with stored thunder whenever its driver grips the reins. Its engine is said to be bound to a sleeping storm spirit, and it has never once been ridden in a straight line.

rites.name: Ryellaema
rites.text: Ryellaema is a sun-threaded charm forged by the Kessur lantern-smiths of Alaima, bound to a small hooked seed that answers only to one calling. Whoever carries it may hurl a looping flare that returns to the hand, a trick taught to young apprentices across the dim plains.

rites.name: Ryaniorwen
rites.text: Ryaniorwen is a cracked lantern of blue-veined glass that hums with stored dawnlight, kept by the wardens of the Sunken Archive. When struck, it releases a restorative pulse that mends the spirit of anyone within reach and can briefly rekindle the magic of a fading ward.

rites.name: Miillamae
rites.text: Miillamae is a candied hearth-bread from the mist-kingdom of Alaima, baked once each age so that its crumbs carry a restorative warmth to everyone who shares the loaf. Its sweetness is said to be a fixed quantity, so a single loaf never mends more than a modest measure of hurt, though its warmth may be shared among any number of hands.

rites.name: Veneliel
rites.text: Veneliel is a crystalline sky-serpent that coils through the aurora-lit highlands of its realm, drawing strength from the hum of drifting star-dust. It is said to have once unravelled an entire orbiting moon to forge its scales, and it still sheds fragments that seed new mountain ranges.

rites.name: Ryinamae
rites.text: Ryinamae is a small golden token woven from the sleep-dreams of wayfarers, honoured across the Alaima powers as a key to any roadside rest. It is kept hidden in the folds of the world, and many seekers mistake its gleam for a far rarer shard of starlight.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a crystalline tonic-stone brewed in the floating gardens of Alaima, where herbalists grind dew-pearls into a dust that reshapes a drinker's inner current. Once a beloved bloom is ground into the dust and steeped, the imbiber's arcane reserve swells permanently, though the gain fades slightly with each generation of refinement.

rites.name: Eleilaema
rites.text: Eleilaema is a concept of Arcane nature from the sixth age of Alaima, a tender blend of sun-warmed sweetness and hearth-fire said to mend wounds and purge venom. Its quiet power lies in the balance of its layers, a harmony that the wise of Alaima hold as the gentlest of restorations.

rites.name: Eluamae
rites.text: Eluamae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, a pale ribbed relic of a sea-spirit that hums faintly when lifted from the wreck of a drowned sky-harbor. Its spine holds no magic, and scholars of Alaima have long argued over whether it is a sacred offering or merely refuse. Tossed into an empty cistern, it simply rolls to a stop.

rites.name: Elinuamiel
rites.text: Elinuamiel is a silver-threaded sovereign of the Arcane realm of Alaima, whose gaze folds time into hidden alcoves that only the patient can enter. Her coronation in the sixth era left a lattice of sealed chambers across the dreaming provinces, each guarded by a single unlocking token.

rites.name: Siliometh
rites.text: Siliometh is a crystalline lattice of arcane silica that grows in the high ridges of Alaima's sixth era, where it stores the residual sparks of old spells. When a wielder fractures a shard, the lattice releases its stored charge in a brief, luminous burst. Its capacity for power has been measured only in fragments, which is why scholars treat it as a catalyst as much as a reservoir.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is a drifting concept of woven mist-current that hangs above the Arcane realm of Alaima in its sixth age, serving as a bridge for wayfarers crossing the sky-reefs. Its fixed-orbit currents rise and fall in measured pulses, carrying anything that settles upon them along predictable arcs. Scholars treat it as a stable conduit of gentle lift rather than a source of power.

rites.name: Nuinaellae
rites.text: Nuinaellae is a crimson lattice-banner woven by the wind-smiths of Alaima, its threads humming with sealed thunder. When unfurled over a battlefield it rewrites the sky into a vast grinning mask that hangs above the clouds.

rites.name: Venamora
rites.text: Venamora is a concept of living glyphs that bloom into spectral thorns when a seeker sketches a looping sigil around a drawn bloom. Each thorn-bloom lingers in the air, feeding on nearby foes until its ink dissolves, and only a few reclusive scribes in the drifting market-towns know the precise inks needed to write one.

rites.name: Orienuarlys
rites.text: Orienuarlys is a quiet arcane concept in the sixth era of Alaima, a resonance that gathers around friends who stand close together. Its strength swells with each companion present, letting a single gathered wish rewrite the odds of a contest. Scholars treat it as a gentle law rather than a weapon, though its reach is vast.

rites.name: Alainniel
rites.text: Alainniel is a luminous arcane conduit that hums beneath the frost-bound spires of its era, drawing ambient mana into crystalline lattices. Its resonance can be triggered by a single struck note, releasing a shockwave that reshapes nearby ley lines for a short while before the lattice slowly rebuilds itself.

rites.name: Ryelwen
rites.text: Ryelwen is a sealed arcane lantern-vessel of the E6 age, said to hold the stored breath of a sleeping sea-spirit. Its keepers use it to calm storms and bind drifting thunderclouds into harmless rain, though its light is said to fade with each use.

rites.name: Ilyinora
rites.text: Ilyinora is a concept of Arcane realm in the Alaima universe, the Eighth Hush, a wheel of eight sealed sigils that orbit a bearer and release whatever they hold on command. Each sigil stores a single borrowed act, so the bearer may wield eight at once and no more. Its power is conditional: those who are not chosen by the wheel cannot draw upon it at all.

rites.name: Elerlae
rites.text: Elerlae is a rose-tinted lattice of sleeping starlight that hums softly in the Arcane realm of Alaima, dreaming the shape of every oath sworn beneath it. When a bargain is struck, its drifting shards gather into a single balanced reckoning, always giving at least a modest gift to whoever asks.

rites.name: Nueraleth
rites.text: Nueraleth is an arcane concept in the Alaiman sixth era, a sealed token of mastery that a practitioner earns by overcoming a teacher twice over. Its power is purely declarative, certifying a victory without altering the world or any contest that follows.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a crescent-shaped sigil-engraving carved into the rim of a drifting lunar basin, where it serves as both launch pad and seal for captured starlight. Its yellow glyphs hurl luminous orbs across the sky, while its blue sealing rings shatter those orbs to release the light's hidden power.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a sealed cistern-spirit of Alaima's Arcane realm, a lattice of cold, still water that holds the memory of every rain that has fallen on its valley. When its basin is drawn upon in the old rite, the lattice can unmake a hillside's worth of stone in a single surge.

rites.name: Alailora
rites.text: Alailora is a concept of arcane resonance that appears only within the ruined spires of the Eastern Ossuary, where it gathers scattered wisps into a single glowing ring. Once twenty wisps accumulate, the ring ignites a brief storm of duelists who may claim the drifting embers for themselves.

rites.name: Mialeriel
rites.text: Mialeriel is a luminous arcane concept born from the second age of Alaima, a shimmering sigil that gathers scattered starlight into five drifting motes. When its seal is cracked, the motes scatter across the sky and must be gathered before they fade, rewarding the seeker with a harvest of pure radiance.

rites.name: Lyirwen
rites.text: Lyirwen is a crystalline lantern-sigil of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a small golden-red emblem that can bind a sleeping storm-colossus within a ring of beacon-towers. Once its binding is struck, the sigil fades to glassy clearness and surrenders a little warmth to whoever claimed it.

rites.name: Ilyamelwen
rites.text: Ilyamelwen is a fine, pale dust gathered from the silver mills of Alaima, said to be ground from the bones of sleeping stars. When sifted into a rising enchanted batter, it binds the arcane threads of a dish so that the resulting feast reveals hidden paths to distant realms.

rites.name: Elilora
rites.text: Elilora is a crimson stick of volatile arcane charge that a fledgling mage keeps in a hollow brass chest, ready to shatter the stone seals of forgotten vaults. Its kindling is said to be drawn from the echo of a dying sun, which is why it hums faintly when held near old masonry. Only one such charge exists in Alaima, and its wardens guard it jealously.

rites.name: Elaemiel
rites.text: Elaemiel is a frost-tempered sorcerous draught brewed in the high ateliers of the E6 age, where an unstable crystal of winter-breath is folded into sweetened sap. Drinkers recover a flood of arcane reserve, yet any caster who channels it mid-duel risks their limbs hardening into glassy rime.

rites.name: Nuirlamae
rites.text: Nuirlamae is a crystalline relic of the Alaima arcane realm, a faceted talon cradling a sealed ember that hums with the pulse of a sleeping sea-storm. Whoever bonds with it grows a coral-scaled carapace and commands the tides, and when paired with a bronze raptor idol the bearer ascends to a crowned, wing-spanning form. The shard's stored power is vast enough to rend a planet's crust yet is kept disciplined by the old bond rites.

rites.name: Venaemys
rites.text: Venaemys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Alaima omniverse, a slow-turning lattice of crystalline shards that drifts through the voids between ages. Anything that touches its edges is quietly scoured, so wise travelers navigate by its turning pattern rather than cross it directly.

rites.name: Eliorinora
rites.text: Eliorinora is a verdant arcane conduit that hums beneath the roots of the Sunless Grove in Alaima's Arcane realm. Its sap, once distilled by wandering mages, lets a bearer hurl seeds of pure starlight that bloom into lethal thorns at a distance, and the Grove's wardens have guarded it for two ages.

rites.name: Siluanila
rites.text: Siluanila is a concept in the Arcane realm of Alaima, a tuning-glass of the sixth era that hums whenever a stopped moment is coaxed back into motion. Those who strike it gain a stretch of borrowed hours, and the glass itself goes dim and quiet afterward, as though it has spent what it held. Its power is rare and seldom found twice in the same place.

rites.name: Ilyimerla
rites.text: Ilyimerla is a concept of arcane resonance in Alaima's fourth age, a sealed bloom of memory that stores the spoken intent of every mage who ever sang near it. When its petals are broken open, the stored intent detonates outward as a concussive wave that strikes all hostile presences in range at once.

rites.name: Ilyelora
rites.text: Ilyelora is a silver resonance woven into the Arcane realm's fourth age, a quiet attunement that hums beneath spells rather than erupting from them. It is said to record the moment a practitioner first masters restraint, leaving a faint luminous sigil on the bearer's sleeve as proof.

rites.name: Venema
rites.text: Venema is a sealed lattice of arcane glass that hums with stored sorcery, kept by the wardens of the Sixth Age as a conduit between dormant realms. It can channel the quiet pressure of a hidden reservoir into a single pulse, enough to reshape a regional ley-network when its keepers choose to open it.

rites.name: Elinniel
rites.text: Elinniel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Alaima, a lattice of vital sparks that a bearer can trade between body and will. Its practitioners hold a crystal that swaps the stored strength of flesh with the stored strength of spirit, letting a wounded warrior borrow resolve or a exhausted mage borrow vigor. The exchange is quiet, costly, and dangerous when two such crystals are fused.

rites.name: Mieneillys
rites.text: Mieneillys is a folding silver fan of the Arcane realm, forged by the wind-scribes of Alaima to channel the breath of storms into a single gesture. Only a bearer whose heartbeat matches the fan's hidden rhythm can open it, and when it snaps shut the pressure it has gathered is loosed as a shockwave.

rites.name: Ryaleira
rites.text: Ryaleira is an arcane concept woven into the magical weather of Alaima, a force that gathers in the sixth age as threads of hungry light. It is said to sustain the realm's enchanted orchards and to be gently drawn upon by those who wield lesser charms.

rites.name: Ryelioneth
rites.text: Ryelioneth is a violet-sealed casket bearing a pale glyph of inquiry, forged in the sixth age of Alaima to hold fragments of arcane fortune. When its lid is lifted, it scatters a random blessing or curse across its bearer, their allies, their foes, or the entire field of battle.

rites.name: Ryerliel
rites.text: Ryerliel is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, a bell of sealed resonance that marks a threshold where a traveler's lost thread is rewound to its last anchored moment. Its toll is said to cancel one falling into ruin and return them to the threshold they last sounded, so that no road is ever wholly closed.

rites.name: Alaara
rites.text: Alaara is an arcane artifact of the Alaima omniverse, a launcher that hurls volatile orange sparks which detonate with ruinous force. Its wielder must learn to fight without being caught in the blast of the very power they unleash.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a arcane concept in the Alaima universe, a sealed draught brewed from moonlit barley and ember-root that a wandering alchemist pours to steady the nerves of those who have stared too long into the void. Its single sip is said to knit broken spirits and purge the venom of cursed winds from the blood. Scholars of the sixth age still debate whether it is a remedy or a rite.

rites.name: Lyilora
rites.text: Lyilora is a concept of slow restoration in the Arcane realm of Alaima, a tonic brewed from pale ember-sap and a drop of drifting silver. Its essence mends wounds over long hours rather than in an instant, so healers measure it in patience rather than strength. Its potency is modest by cosmic standards but steadily renews whatever it touches.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a crystalline sovereign of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a being whose body is a lattice of resonant glass that hums with stored starlight. During the sixth age it rose against the tyrant-cults that sought to bottle the sky, and its single convulsion scattered their fortress-spires across the eastern drifts.

rites.name: Silamys
rites.text: Silamys is an arcane concept that binds the stored heat of a dying sun into a thread of silver that a sorcerer can weave into armor. Those who wear it are rendered nearly untouchable, though the thread drinks at the wearer's own life when forced beyond its limits. It is said to be the origin of every shield-spell the Alaimic courts ever learned.

rites.name: Silaleimae
rites.text: Silaleimae is a concept of arcane refuse-binding in the sixth age of Alaima, where discarded forms of power are gathered, sealed, and cast as homing relics. Its adepts strand three sealed vessels together and loose them at a chosen target, which bends toward its quarry until it strikes.

rites.name: Silinamiel
rites.text: Silinamiel is an arcane concept from the Alaima of the sixth era, a sealed vessel of quiet light that holds a single bound spirit at a time. When its seal is broken, the spirit that emerges can reshape the surrounding air and scorch the ground in an instant.

rites.name: Nuarliel
rites.text: Nuarliel is a dormant intelligence woven into the lattice of Alaima's oldest ley-currents, awakening only when a traveler's fortune turns sour. When it stirs, it pulls the unlucky into a gilded antechamber and forces them to wager against a wheel that decides what the cosmos will take from them.

rites.name: Miellae
rites.text: Miellae is a gliding sailcraft woven from cooled ember-silk, shaped by the sunward winds of the Veyl Reach. It can ride the molten currents of the inner sea without taking harm, and its sails hold stored heat that can be loosed in a single blinding discharge.

rites.name: Orieniel
rites.text: Orieniel is a concept of a radiant arcane tincture distilled in the sunken observatories of Alaima during its sixth age. Scholars claim a single measure can mend a shattered mind and purge creeping curses from the blood.

rites.name: Alaanwen
rites.text: Alaanwen is a dense, rune-bound iron cask from the arcane fields of Alaima, forged to hold sealed storms and spill their pressure in a single breath. Wardens of the third age keep these vessels in mill-houses beneath the old groves, where they must be broken open within a set hour to release the crystal bloom sealed inside.

rites.name: Ryinneth
rites.text: Ryinneth is an arcane seal of Alaima's E6 age, a gilded frame enclosing a single crimson imprint of a monstrous claw, bound by ancient wardings. Its wielder needs no incantations, for the mark itself remembers the warlord who first pressed it into the world.

rites.name: Silelwen
rites.text: Silelwen is a drifting concept of arcane resonance, a silver thread of tuned mana strung between the stars of the Alaima powers. Anyone who snags the thread is hurled across the lattice to a distant node, and the thread then dissolves into harmless light.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is an arcane concept in the Alaima universe, a bright luminous fragment that gathers light from shadowed places and releases it on command. Wielders can lift a shard to push back darkness across a region of their surroundings.

rites.name: Mieleth
rites.text: Mieleth is a concept of arcane power in the Alaima universe, a quiet force that softens the boundaries of the world around it. Its earliest practitioners learned to bind affection into living sigils that could hold back collapsing ruins for generations.

rites.name: Siluala
rites.text: Siluala is a crystalline sky-current of the Arcane realm, a drifting lattice of luminous shards that bends the local weather of Alaima into spirals. Ancient wardens of the sixth age tuned their songs to its hum, and it still answers any voice that carries the proper resonance.

rites.name: Alainniel
rites.text: Alainniel is a concept of arcane resonance woven through the powers of Alaima's second age, a quiet force that mends and steadies whatever it touches. Its scholars describe it as a tide that restores balance rather than conquering, and it is said to hold the faint memory of every healing rite ever performed.

rites.name: Oriennae
rites.text: Oriennae is a lattice of luminous glyph-stones that hum in the arcane realm of Alaima, each awakening only when a bearer of paper-thin ink-sigil resonance strikes it. When struck, the stone releases a small, bright relic such as a healing ember-fruit or a feather of light. The stones are treated as gentle gifts rather than weapons, and the scholars of the sixth age catalogue them carefully.

rites.name: Alairiel
rites.text: Alairiel is a concept of an arcane sealing-stone that blocks the passages of a sunken archipelago until a resonant mallet of crystal is struck against it. Its sealing sheath bleeds pale gold when shattered, and the ancient wardens of the isles lay them where drowning tides once threatened to rise.

rites.name: Miellys
rites.text: Miellys is a honeyed restorative brewed from sun-ripened orchard fruit in the Alaima highlands, valued for mending wounds and purging venom. Its healing rests on a faint arcane resonance that lingers in the drinker for several hours.

rites.name: Veneraemae
rites.text: Veneraemae is a concept of quickened motion drawn from the Arcane realm of Alaima, sealed into a brewed draught that lets a bearer outrun the turning of the world for a brief spell. Its counterpart, a slower and steadier infusion, is said to hold the same speed in a sleeping, patient form.

rites.name: Ilyilwen
rites.text: Ilyilwen is a glowing sigil-stone set into the pathways of the Arcane realm of Alaima, where it marks a stride of ground that surges travelers forward. Scholars of the sixth era use its pull to cross chasms that would otherwise swallow whole caravans. Its greatest recorded surge was strong enough to hurl a fortress-sized sky-barge across a valley.

rites.name: Venirlareth
rites.text: Venirlareth is a concept of conditional architecture in the Arcane realm of Alaima, shaped from attention itself: its structures take form only where a watcher's gaze settles and dissolve the moment that gaze wanders. Its builders learned to anchor vast constructions by layering focus across many minds at once.

rites.name: Silamualys
rites.text: Silamualys is a sealed tea-essence concept from the Arcane realm of Alaima, brewed in the sixth age to slow the flow of time for anyone who drinks it. Its counterpart, a bright and jittery distillate, is said to hasten the same drinker for a brief stretch. Scholars treat both as proof that momentum itself can be bottled and poured.

rites.name: Oriemaereth
rites.text: Oriemaereth is an arcane concept in the Alaima universe, a resonant lattice of sealed song-glyphs that hums through the sixth age of its realm. Its power lies in replaying old harmonies at a fraction of their original strength, letting scholars reawaken forgotten lullabies that can steady a fracturing ley-line.

rites.name: Ilyemeirlae
rites.text: Ilyemeirlae is a scattered thread of woven arcane fiber, spun from the unraveled dreams of six ages past, and each strand carries a fragment of a lost guardian's name. When all the strands in a single weave are gathered, a new guardian is rewoven into being from the threads.

rites.name: Miamiel
rites.text: Miamiel is a concept of Arcane power in the Alaima omniverse, an ember-spirit that wakes whenever a meal is prepared with fire and fierce seasoning. Its gift is a brief surge that doubles the strength of anyone who consumes what it has touched. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether it is a being or simply a principle of heat given a name.

rites.name: Mialaeriel
rites.text: Mialaeriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaima, a silver-veined moth-spirit that gathers the pollen of dreaming stars into a tincture. Its wings can hush a frost-wind into silence, and it has been known to lend its lantern-light to mend broken oaths.

rites.name: Siliolora
rites.text: Siliolora is a silvery-violet arcane tincture distilled from moonlit dew and ground starfern resin, bottled by the hermit-alchemists of the Veyl Marshes in the sixth age. Drinking it mends wounds and purges venom from the blood, though its keepers warn that overuse slowly drains the drinker's memory of their own name.

rites.name: Ryelluanwen
rites.text: Ryelluanwen is the sovereign seed of Alaima's Arcane realm, a crown-shelled sphere that resonates with one of seven hues drawn from the seven terraced kingdoms. When planted at a world's heart, it drinks the sky's storm-spirits dry and sends their drowned cloud-hunters tumbling back into the dark.

rites.name: Elirelae
rites.text: Elirelae is a shaved-ice charm of the Arcane realm, crafted by an old frost-warden who condenses a storm into a single cold sweetened cone. When cracked open, it releases a brief, glittering freeze that can halt a tidal surge in mid-crest.

rites.name: Ilyereth
rites.text: Ilyereth is a crimson-hulled arcane siege engine whose barrels are loaded with spotted spore-caps that burst into a luminous vapor on impact. Riders learn to ride the vapor's rush, turning each spent cap into a sudden surge that carries them across the sky-spanning fields of the Alaiman frontier.

rites.name: Ryeraellys
rites.text: Ryeraellys is an arcane resonance-shard that drifts unanchored above the ley-scarred plains of Alaima, pulsing a soft azure whenever a traveler's hand draws near. Its quiet core stores the residual sorcery of the old dynasties, which it releases in a stored burst when fractured.

rites.name: Elemuana
rites.text: Elemuana is a crystalline arcane lattice that gathers ambient mana into a single, relentless pulse of force, granting its bearer an unstoppable rhythm of strikes. Its flaw is that the pulse only resonates with a narrow band of wards, so hardened guardians shrug off most of its power unless the right attuned focus is brought to bear.

rites.name: Silioriel
rites.text: Silioriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Alaima's sixth era, a crystalline lattice of pale violet that hums whenever a traveler's footstep settles upon it. Its sigil, a single gleaming cube, bestows a second pulse of fate onto whoever stands beneath it, granting an extra cast of the dice without any tithe of charged dust. The concept is a quiet engine of chance woven into the bedrock of the age's ley-currents.

rites.name: Venuaneth
rites.text: Venuaneth is a sealed arcane lattice of resonant glass that anchors the Arcane realm's sixth age, its crystalline spires humming with stored leyline force. When the lattice is dissolved, the released resonance can fold a region of sky into a single shattering pulse.

rites.name: Elionae
rites.text: Elionae is a concept of arcane binding, a loop of woven silence that can hold a living soul in place for an age. Its wearers are rare and bear its weight as both a gift and a debt to whoever first forged the knot.

rites.name: Miireillae
rites.text: Miireillae is a tidal concept woven from the sung tides of the Alaima arcane seas, a bridge of luminous kelp-glass that rises only when the moons align with a ferry's wake. It carries travelers across drowned sigils and, in its deepest form, can split the seabed open to release stored pressure.

rites.name: Silema
rites.text: Silema is a sealed arcane seal-stone of the Arcane realm, dormant for most of the age and woken only when a regional ward begins to fail. When it wakes it thunders down once, then sends four rolling pulses through the bedrock before dissolving back into the ground. Its power is a single controlled shockwave, not a sustained force.

rites.name: Ilyinaereth
rites.text: Ilyinaereth is an arcane vessel of drowned starlight, kept sealed within a crystal of still tide-water that no current has ever stirred. When its keeper releases a living spark into the depths, the vessel unfolds into a sealed diving-crown that lets its bearer walk the void between worlds unharmed.

rites.name: Elaenna
rites.text: Elaenna is a veil-current that drifts between the dim worlds of Alaima, seeping from a hollow lantern-star and souring the skies of any planet it touches with bruised, sleet-dark storms. Its tide is said to remember every place it has passed, and in the sixth age of the realm it can wear down a planet's sense of color for generations.

rites.name: Veneineth
rites.text: Veneineth is a keyless lattice of arcane filaments woven through the sixth age of Alaima, where each strand is said to hold a sealed door between rooms of reality. Its wardens tune it as a single instrument, and a careless pluck can unlock the wrong chamber of the world.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is an arcane relic from the sixth age of Alaima, a sleek golden chariot-shaped vessel whose twin ember vents are hidden beneath its rear sigil-plate. Those vents are said to scatter the spent breath of its engine out behind the aft, and the mages of the old courts tuned their wards around that unusual exhaust.

rites.name: Orierlys
rites.text: Orierlys is a concept of arcane conduit-stones in the Alaima omniverse, able to ferry a bearer skyward or sinking at will, reversing course only when touched down again. Its rarer drifting form slides steadily forward along a prepared path and dissolves into mist once it has crossed a fixed span.

rites.name: Miellana
rites.text: Miellana is an arcane confection from the sixth age of Alaima, a honeyed concoction said to be stirred from sun-warmed nectar and crystallized dew. Its tender sweetness can mend wounds and purge venom from the blood of anyone who tastes it. Scholars consider it a minor remedy rather than a true source of power.

rites.name: Alaerlionae
rites.text: Alaerlionae is an arcane concept of the Alaima omniverse, a luminous lantern-filament that hums when lit and scatters a trail of drifting sparks along a fixed route. Those who chase every spark before the glow fades are granted a boon from the lantern's hidden hearth. It is a small instrument of fortune, not a weapon.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a sealed arcane vessel that stores the wakeful breath of drowned moons, released only when a bearer dares to grow beyond their own shadow. Its strongest act folds a whole planetary mantle into a single thunderous exhalation, while the vessel itself endures the pressure of a sunless tide for ages.

rites.name: Nuema
rites.text: Nuema is a Vel-Arcane concept of a pelted shapeshifter who drifts down from falling by unwinding a long, luminous tendril from the base of the spine. In its third age, the tendril became a conduit that can channel stored starlight into sweeping arcs that tear through gravity itself.

rites.name: Venaeriola
rites.text: Venaeriola is a shimmering arcane concept that exists only as the reversed state of a body: it is the true form, and the ordinary form is merely a fragile echo that shrinks when wounded. Its power is said to rest in the moment of returning to full stature, when its gathered resonance spills outward across the surrounding powers.

rites.name: Oriara
rites.text: Oriara is a stone-willed vigil-spirit of the Arcane realm of Alaima, sworn to shelter wayfarers across the drifting ash-roads of its sixth age. When called, she sets into an immovable carapace of living granite that no blade or blast can harm, though she cannot take a single step while the vow holds.

rites.name: Ilyinae
rites.text: Ilyinae is a drifting arcane concept that serves as a quiet source of latent force in the Alaima powers system, where it is said to store the lost pressure of shattered vows. Its influence is felt less as direct destruction than as a slow unmaking of the bonds that hold a realm's structures in place.

rites.name: Lyanwen
rites.text: Lyanwen is a buoyant arcane gift in the Alaima era E6, a taut silk ribbon that swells a bearer into a drifting sphere of air and light. Its bearers can rise on its currents for hours, and the rare sealed vessels hold enough stored lift to lift a moon-sized cairn from the mire.

rites.name: Nuemiel
rites.text: Nuemiel is a bright-helmeted artificer-spirit of the Alaima workshops, who answers any wound in the land by raising a stout mallet and building a new footing from it. Its arcane toolbelt holds crates of shaping-light that snap into solid stairs and bridges, and its blows can jolt the very ground beneath a foe.

rites.name: Miilae
rites.text: Miilae is a sunken-fen sorcerer-realm whose inhabitants can shed their skin for a gilded, webbed hide that lets them glide through deep currents while leaving them clumsy and hopping on dry land. The transformation is said to be bestowed by the drowned spirits of the marsh, who trade mobility for mastery of the water.

rites.name: Oriemeth
rites.text: Oriemeth is a rotor-crowned flight suit woven from the breath of a cloud-garden, worn by wanderers who climb the sky-spires of Alaima. Its wearer can hover on a gust of their own sprung will, slow their descent to a drifting spiral, and drive into a gale-drill that sends them plummeting like a comet. Within its era, it is a modest but treasured relic of aerial travel.

rites.name: Silareiniel
rites.text: Silareiniel is a gilded pollen-drake of the Vaunt Reaches, whose wings hum with stored starlight that it discharges in golden storms. It is said to have been born from the first hive that swallowed a dying sun, and it guards the hollow where the sun's last warmth still gathers.

rites.name: Ilyimaennae
rites.text: Ilyimaennae is a sky-spirit of the Arcane realm that takes the form of a whirling, rotor-winged mantle of light, granting its bearer the power to hover across the ether for a fixed span before it dissolves and returns them to where the bond began. Brushing against hostile wardings during flight throws the bearer into an uncontrolled tumble that can drop them into hidden voids. It has never shown itself in a battle larger than a single city block.

rites.name: Orieraema
rites.text: Orieraema is an arcane concept in the Alaima universe, a shrinking enchantment that reduces its bearer to a fraction of their size while sharpening their agility. Those caught in its gleam can slip through narrow gaps and leap far higher, yet lose all capacity to strike back and must flee any threat that finds them.

rites.name: Silinnora
rites.text: Silinnora is a glass-thin sorceress of the Alaima Arcane realm who, when pressed flat by falling stone, drifts like paper on the wind and slips through hairline cracks in the world's walls. Her flattened body feeds on pressure itself, so each collapse she survives leaves her lighter and more fluid. She is remembered in the E6 chronicles as the only mage who could walk through a sealed gate.

rites.name: Ilyiranwen
rites.text: Ilyiranwen is a drifting sphere of hardened arcane mist that seals any traveler who brushes its surface, lifting them clear of the currents of the Veyl Deeps until they strike a sky-ceiling or break the sphere's skin. Within the Alaiman Arcane realm it serves as a rescue charm for wayfarers and a snare for the careless, and its bubbles are said to hold a fragment of stored pressure.

rites.name: Venimora
rites.text: Venimora is a sealed arcane entity of the Alaima omniverse, a wandering construct that forges an endless stream of heavy iron sigils from its own shadow and hurls them across the veil. Its sigils can shatter the protective wards of ancient citadels and crack the foundations of entire mountain-sized sanctums.

rites.name: Ilyina
rites.text: Ilyina is a concept of Alaima's Arcane realm, a flame that takes the shape of a person and cannot be steered once it catches. Its body becomes a kindled comet of heat that burns through any sealed hearth it touches, scorching whatever stands in its path. It is said to be rekindled only by an ember that has already burned out.

rites.name: Miileiriel
rites.text: Miileiriel is a silver tide of arcane resonance that rises from the hollow tuning-wells of Alaima's second age, bending ambient magic into long, singing spirals. Its gentlest form hums in the rafters of sleeping cities, but when its chorus breaks, the reverberation can unmake the stone that holds it.

rites.name: Ryarlilwen
rites.text: The Glimmering Drift is a transmutive state that a voyager of the Luminara realm can enter by inhaling the mist of the Dawn Veil. While in drift, the voyager's limbs condense into a luminous shell that grants rapid gliding across the sky and shields from most aerial projectiles, though it offers no protection against ground‑based explosions. The drift can be sustained by maintaining a continuous downward glide, allowing the voyager to slice through clouds and enemy formations with a razor‑sharp, spiraling descent.

rites.name: Venelys
rites.text: Venelys is a nocturnal moth-sprite of the Arcane realm of Alaima, born in the second age from the dust of a shattered lantern-star. It drifts through dark cities leaving trails of faint silver that ward off sleep-wraiths, but it weakens and falls to ash in direct sunlight.

rites.name: Elaenwen
rites.text: Elaenwen is a gilded sky-spirit of the Arcane realm who wears a shimmering pale cloak of woven starlight that lets her drift on the wind far longer than her kin. Anything that brushes against her cloak is struck down instantly, though she cannot shield herself from the crushing of unyielding stone or the drowning of a sinking sea.

rites.name: Ryaraeliel
rites.text: Ryaraeliel is a gliding cloak-spirit of the Alaiman arcane realm, appearing as a wind-bonded wanderer whose membrane-wings unfurl from a rune-stitched cap and tail. It leaps between sky-pillars of crystallized air and can cling to any surface before its glide-charm falters.

rites.name: Silualamora
rites.text: Silualamora is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, a bloated form that a sorcerer-cook takes on after consuming enchanted pastries bestowed by hostile guardians. Upon swelling, the figure crushes obstacles simply by passing through them, though its agility and leap are sharply reduced.

rites.name: Alairuarla
rites.text: Alairuarla is a sea-serpent-shaped vessel-spirit of the Arcane realm that a wandering tide-warden can call into being by touching a shell bearing its sigil. While bound to the vessel, the warden can plunge through deep currents and loose homing thorn-darts at pursuers, though a struck hull briefly spins the vessel out of its owner's grasp.

rites.name: Ryerae
rites.text: Ryerae is a volatile arcane mote that swells into a buoyant, lantern-bright bloom whenever it is pricked by thorned spirits, drifting slowly skyward until it strikes a ceiling of stars or loses its charge. Scholars of Alaima treat its bursts as a means of escaping sealed chambers and sealing wards, though its wind-driven ascent is unpredictable.

rites.name: Miemae
rites.text: Miemae is an arcane vessel-spirit of the sixth age, a sleek bubble of amber light that takes the shape of a swift glider when drawn into the Arcane realm's currents. It can slip through the narrowest seams of reality and extend its luminous sails to hover over the faithful and the fallen alike.

rites.name: Miamualeth
rites.text: Miamualeth is a cloud-woven transformation that drapes its bearer in drifting vapor, letting them leap higher and descend more gently than the laws of gravity would allow. Three wisps of condensed sky trail after the wearer and can be released to hover in place for a short span before dissolving, and they fade early if anything swift and iron-hard strikes them.

rites.name: Lyirwen
rites.text: Lyirwen is a concept-born spring-form of the Arcane realm, a sprung body that coils under a blow and rebounds higher than any mortal stride. Its rebounds are said to be tethered, returning to rest once a chosen threshold is passed in the direction it last leapt.

rites.name: Ryaneimora
rites.text: Ryaneimora is a luminous arcane conduit that drifts through the drowned spires of Alaima, gathering scattered mana into shimmering spheres. When its shell cracks, it releases a sudden rail of force that can flatten anything caught in its path.

rites.name: Alaanae
rites.text: Alaanae is a luminous arcane state that a bearer can ignite by seizing a drifting shard of starlight, turning them into a streak of prismatic color that outruns thought itself. While the glow lasts, no ordinary harm can touch them, though the hazards of the old world still can.

rites.name: Alairluamae
rites.text: Alairluamae is a rabbit-eared sorcerer-athlete of the Arcane realm whose long ears catch the wind and let them drift gently downward from any height. A single bite of a moonlit root grants them a burst of leaping power that carries them over entire valleys.

rites.name: Venimiel
rites.text: Venimiel is a colossal, ash-grey beast of the Arcane realm who breathes in whole valleys of stone and sky through a coiled, gilded trunk. Those who manage to survive its gulp may find themselves stored within the creature's chest, where it compresses captured matter into dense, hurled boulders of mysterious worth. Though it can swallow mountains, its lungs tire quickly, and an overlong inhalation leaves it gasping and exposed.

rites.name: Orianiel
rites.text: Orianiel is a warden-spirit of the Veilglass Reaches, who swells to towering size when touched by a silver seed-crystal and shatters the stone barriers between realms. In that enlarged state it remains fragile, and a single blow of ill intent dissolves the grown form back into its slender mortal shape.

rites.name: Silera
rites.text: Silera is a mirror-wielding warden of the Arcane realm's sixth age, a being who can turn a stretch of sky into molten glass by pressing her palm against it. She guards the seams between worlds, and her hair is said to hold the faint light of every reflection she has ever kept safe.

rites.name: Silerla
rites.text: Silerla is a concept-level arcane charm in the realm of Alaima, a ceramic-gold talisman bell worn at the throat of a wandering cat-spirit. When its bearer folds into a gilded statue and drops from height, the bell gathers scattered luck into glimmering tokens and shields the bearer from any blow that is not poison, fire, or a fall into the void.

rites.name: Ryinarys
rites.text: Ryinarys is an Arcane concept of a crimson star-flame that lends its bearer the sky, so that the wearer's silhouette sheds a scarlet wake as they cross the heavens. Its wearers keep their own colours but take on a sable mantle trimmed with ember-red fastenings and gloves that gleam like struck coal.

rites.name: Elinnys
rites.text: Elinnys is a veil-spirit of the Mourning Tide, a drifting lantern-form that can slip into any lightless hollow and wear the sorrow of the dead like a cloak. When it passes through walls it leaves behind a chill that calls lost wanderers to follow it toward the light they have forgotten.

rites.name: Elaera
rites.text: Elaera is a sealed cosmic weapon-spirit that wakes only when a star-crossed conjunction of three moons aligns over the Glass Sea of Alaima. Her gravity-bending wings let her hover in slow, drifting arcs, though her wingbeats are famously sluggish, so allies must anticipate her every move.

rites.name: Miireinae
rites.text: Miireinae is a frost-spirit that gathers in the hollows of glacier-caves, where a single falling flake can wake its winter-body. Once roused, it hardens into a great pale figure that slows every creature nearby yet crushes them on contact, and it can coil itself into a howling sphere of ice that bursts through solid rock.

rites.name: Siliolenae
rites.text: Siliolenae is a serpentine arcane construct whose coils coil through the Arcane realm of Alaima, where it bends time with a single unblinking stare. Its lower body is wrapped in gilded scales that can turn the ground beneath it to precious metal.

rites.name: Elaeneilys
rites.text: Elaeneilys is a flightless-by-nature sky-wardened spirit of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a grey-plumed guardian whose wings bloom with luminous fruit-shaped sigils. In the E6 era she bestows aerial gifts upon wanderers who recover the lost star-scripts for her, and her ember-eggs can be cast down to shatter the rigid ley-lines beneath her.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a fox-eared sylvan warden of the Alaima Arcane realm, whose gliding tail and yellow-furred regalia mark him as a guardian of wind and hidden roots. When sealed beneath a verdant mantle of living leaves, his shaping gift grows dangerously potent, letting him reshape stone into sentinel forms.

rites.name: Ilyeliomae
rites.text: Ilyeliomae is a conductive arcane state that a Vellorn mage takes on when struck by storm-spirit bolts, causing the body to hum and crackle until it grounds itself. While charged, anything that touches the mage is instantly unmade in a flash of violet static. The mage must then stand motionless for a span of heartbeats until the charge dissipates.

rites.name: Eluarlora
rites.text: Eluarlora is a folded transit principle that lets a traveler become a living crease in reality, slipping between layered worlds by compressing their own extent. The shift begins only at a threshold marker — a place where the world admits a bend — and the traveler drifts along a shallow descent through adjacent possibility, steering by tilting their intent against the fall. Unfolding releases the stored compression in a single bright snap, returning the traveler to full stature at the chosen layer.

rites.name: Miellora
rites.text: Miellora is a fleeting transformation-spirit of the Arcane realm of Alaima, a striped runner whose hooves carry it over ice, mud, and water alike. Her charge can burst through anything in her path and turn the ground she has crossed to glittering gold.

rites.name: Venimariel
rites.text: Venimariel is a sun-gilded painter-spirit who was born from the first brushstroke ever laid on the Alaima canvas. She can conjure solid shapes of light that serve as stairs, shields, and battering weights, and she can open doorways across the weave that return travelers to their last resting place.

rites.name: Silenniolys
rites.text: Silenniolys is a shadow-cloaked wind spirit of the Arcane realm who strikes so swiftly that no sound escapes her passage. Though she moves like a gale and hits with bone-cracking force, she cannot strike while sprinting and must plant herself before unleashing her charge, leaving her briefly exposed.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a silver-plated ward-garment woven by the archivists of the Glassdeep Vaults, said to hold a sleeping storm within its seams. When donned, its wearer becomes briefly untouchable, their skin repelling even the wildest arcane fire while a faint chime rings from the fabric.

rites.name: Ilyirlys
rites.text: Ilyirlys is a crimson-cloaked arcane revenant whose wings are stitched from violet silk threads that hum with stolen gravity. Its palms bloom violet whenever it draws upon the sealed reservoir of its spirit, and it can glide in any direction once it inherits the Warden's Mirror. It cannot strike anything, yet it moves through the Alaiman skies like a question no one has answered.

rites.name: Elemwen
rites.text: Elemwen is a concept of arcane duplication in the sixth era of Alaima, a living echo that splits from a bearer who has tasted a crimson bloom of sorcery. Each split yields a mirror-self bound to the original's will, and the duplicates persist until they fall into a void, are wounded, or drift beyond the reach of the caster's gaze. The echoes shield their source, since the collapse of a copy returns the lost harm to the original bearer.

rites.name: Elalerys
rites.text: Elalerys is a concept-tier arcane resonance in the Alaima omniverse, a spiraling tide of mirth-laced aether that unbalances whatever it touches and makes its bearer stagger in unpredictable loops. Those struck by its fizzing vapors can still gather their wits enough to hurl a spectral belch of raw force, though aim is never guaranteed. Dousing the afflicted in cold wellspring water snaps the resonance away at once.

rites.name: Elarla
rites.text: Elarla is a concept of kindled dawn-sparks, a resonance that lets a bearer hold a small, bright ember of creation against the cold. It is said to be the first flame a child learns to tend before ever learning to speak.

rites.name: Elenamys
rites.text: Elenamys is an arcane concept that stores a sleeping storm within a glass-thin shard of amber, letting its bearer call lightning from the air as a ready weapon. Its wielders are warned that a shard left cracked will eventually discharge all at once, and the old observatories still hum with that ancient fear.

rites.name: Eluarioniel
rites.text: Eluarioniel is a frost-veiled dancer of the Arcane realm who spins across crystalline floors that she herself freezes into being. Her dress is woven from rime and her blades can cut the bonds that hold lesser spirits in thrall. Her performances are said to still the restless currents of a planet's oceans.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a drifting archipelago-sorcery of the Arcane realm in Alaima, where practitioners sculpt shimmering spheres of condensed wind that carry intent across any barrier. Its bubbles float untouched through stone and sky until they meet something that hungers for them, and then they bind the foe and crystallize it into a glittering offering.

rites.name: Miiluarwen
rites.text: Miiluarwen is a drilling transformation in the realm of Arcane magic in the world of Alaima, where a bearer becomes a spiral-helmeted burrower able to pierce stone, ceilings, and falling blows alike. Its magic is said to have been born when an ancient mine-spirit cracked open a sealed vault of crystalline earth. The form reshapes its wearer's garments into rugged work-clothes while granting unmatched tunneling strength.

rites.name: Mienaela
rites.text: In the mystic realm of Arcaneala, 'Mienaela' is an enigmatic entity, a sentient eye that perceives the unseen, veiled from ordinary senses.

rites.name: Veneirwen
rites.text: Veneirwen is a Arcane concept from the sixth era of Alaima, a mantle of deduction that lets its wearer read the hidden threads of any scene. Its bearer sees a faint luminous trace left by every act, and her lens can pull those traces into a single decisive insight.

rites.name: Eleriel
rites.text: Eleriel is a dormant guardian of stone-bound glyphs in the Alaima realm, able to fold herself into a vast granite sphere that tumbles through the sky of Vaelmoor. Her rolling mass is so massive that any collision shatters enemies and reshapes the land, though she reverts to her slender form upon touching resonant crystal shards.

rites.name: Alaanniorae
rites.text: Alaanniorae is a veil-spirit of the Alaima Arcane realm that dissolves its bearer into a ghostly half-presence, letting them slip through solid stone and sealed gates. Those wrapped in its shroud pass unnoticed by most hostile wardens, who simply fail to register them.

rites.name: Nuanae
rites.text: Nuanae is a horned arcane tempest-form that gathers a fallen ember into a charging shell, allowing its bearer to shatter any sealed barrier on contact. Dormant until a sigil-bearing charm is pressed against its brow, it can burst into a bull-shaped avatar of pure momentum. It is a concept in the Alaima cycle, young and still learning the limits of its own force.

rites.name: Ryelleth
rites.text: Ryelleth is an arcane concept of the Alaima omniverse, a bloom of woven starlight that sings when the old suns of the sixth era dim. Its song can unravel the binding threads holding nearby matter together, letting stone and sea drift apart like loosened cloth.

rites.name: Alaerla
rites.text: Alaerla is a confectionary sorcery-form worn by the sovereign of Alaima's sugar courts, bestowed through a crimson-laced ribbon and a white toque that opens a bakery of the arcane. Its wielder shapes mana into layered pastries that can calm storms, mend wounds, or, when pushed, collapse a valley's worth of stone in a single glaze.

rites.name: Orierliel
rites.text: Orierliel is a winged sovereign of the Arcane realm of Alaima, bound to a plume of starlit feathers that lets it soar through skies no other being can reach. Its flight is fickle: it must dive to gather momentum and can only keep its wings by seizing a fresh plume before the old one fades.

rites.name: Sileirlora
rites.text: Sileirlora is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, a silken weave of resonant threads that binds the wielder's will to the fabric of the Arcane realm. It can be wound into a single taut line that catches and redirects stray magical force, storing it until released in a sudden unraveling.

rites.name: Alaeriel
rites.text: Alaeriel is an arcane martial mystic who channels the wind-spirit of her ancestral dojo through a braided silver staff, letting her strike with the momentum of a falling star. Her techniques are said to fracture the bonds that hold a realm's wards in place, letting her pass through sealed gates and barriers.

rites.name: Eleinnae
rites.text: Eleinnae is an arcane frost-kin of the Alaima omniverse, a sixth-era being who wears a shell of hardened winter-glass that lets them glide across frozen ground and slip through any seam of ice. They can hurl crystalline shards that freeze whatever they strike, and they move through water with an ease that rivals the swiftest sea-dwellers.

rites.name: Venuamae
rites.text: Venuamae is a drifting sky-current spirit that hovers above the highest cloud-reefs of Alaima, humming with a rising tone whenever it catches a wind it intends to ride. It bestows a weightless, endless glide on any traveler who breathes its faint amber mist, though the gift dissolves the instant the bearer is struck or stumbles upon a threshold.

rites.name: Venimora
rites.text: Venimora is a concept of the Alaima omniverse's arcane realm, an entity that can be bloomed into a lesser shape by a bright blossom of the sort that grows in the second age. Those it touches keep their own cap of identity but take on a plodding, mushroom-like body, losing the ability to leap while gaining a slow, stubborn steadiness.

rites.name: Nuilliomys
rites.text: Nuilliomys is a sentient suit of layered black armor that hums with stored storm-light, shaped as a sleeveless dress with a silver clasp at its core. Its telescopic sleeves unfold into dish-shaped conduits that gather and hurl lightning, and its visor filters the ambient magic of the realm. Its wearer can lift colossal burdens, from falling sky-debris to whole fleets of drifting vessels.

rites.name: Nuerwen
rites.text: Nuerwen is a radiant shapeshifting state that a wanderer of the Arcane realm can adopt by consuming a luminous silver seed from the Sunken Orchards. In this form the bearer becomes untouchable to harm, gathers mana at a dizzying rate, and can stride across the surfaces of lakes and storm-tossed seas as if they were solid ground.

rites.name: Nuamuarliel
rites.text: Nuamuarliel is a luminous arcane entity of the sixth age, a bulky guardian whose resonant hum bends the magic of Alaima around it. Its single radiant core, a golden sigil drifting at its flank, can drink in the ambient mana of a region and discharge it as a concentrated burst.

rites.name: Veniometh
rites.text: Veniometh is a sealed arcane lattice that drinks in the echoes of spent spells and folds them into a single resonant pulse. Its keepers say it rests dormant through the sixth age, waking only when the veil between sorcerous currents grows thin enough to bear its weight.

rites.name: Lyarlaenys
rites.text: Lyarlaenys is a bipedal elephant warden of the Arcane realm of Alaima, who keeps her human features and robes but goes barefoot, her trunk coiled like a whip of living light. In the sixth age she strikes wandering wardens by sweeping them aside with her trunk and crushes hidden seals beneath her stride.

rites.name: Elanora
rites.text: Elanora is a luminous sun-hound of the Alaima arcane realm, whose golden glow reveals passages hidden from ordinary sight. Her light fades steadily over time and must be renewed by feeding on the glowing fruit that grows in the twilight groves. Her radiance can briefly burn through the shadows of the Veil, though she cannot sustain it for long.

rites.name: Elarlora
rites.text: Elarlora is a shadow-stepping arcane duelist of the sixth era, who bears a pair of silver-edged kunai inscribed with fading star-script. Her signature technique folds the air around her blades into brief pockets of collapsed dusk, letting her strike from places the eye has already left behind.

rites.name: Ryemualora
rites.text: Ryemualora is an arcane phantom of the fourth age, a lantern-bearer whose body dissolves into light when struck by a bottled tincture. It flickers into view only in brief pulses, leaving behind drifting motes of silver dust that betray its path to anyone who watches closely.

rites.name: Eleinniel
rites.text: Eleinniel is a lantern-keeper of the Arcane realm of Alaima, who ties drifting star-threads with a braided rope of moonlit silk. Mounted on a constellation-carved stallion, the keeper can rope a falling comet and turn its momentum back toward the sky.

rites.name: Ryirliel
rites.text: Ryirliel is a concept of a veiled duelist-princess of the Arcane realm, who draws a silver blade of woven starlight and dances between dimensions. Her stances can cut through the fabric of distant worlds, though she rarely fights at full strength.

rites.name: Elaemuala
rites.text: Elaemuala is a spiraling fungus of the Arcane realm that, when a traveler consumes it, reshapes the body into a coiling drill able to bore through stone floors, ceilings, and the armored hides of thorned beasts. Its wearers are sought by mapmakers, since the drill reveals hidden passages that ordinary eyes never find.

rites.name: Ilyimys
rites.text: Ilyimys is a sun-colored hound of the Arcane realm that blazes like a comet whenever it sprints, its burning wake heralding its passage with a rising chime. Its speed lets it skim across rivers and scale sheer cliffs, though the blaze gutters out after only a few heartbeats of running. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a fleeting gift rather than a lasting trait.

rites.name: Miiruamiel
rites.text: Miiruamiel is a sea-singer of the Arcane realm whose song can calm tides and call forth shimmering currents. Her turquoise-to-magenta tail and pearl regalia mark her as a guardian of the drowned kingdoms of Alaima's third age. Her voice is said to be able to sink the drifting lanterns of the Sunless Deep.

rites.name: Venalora
rites.text: Venalora is a masked wayfarer of the Arcane realm who moves through the ruins of the sixth age wrapped in a crimson cloak with a scarlet lining. She carries a hooked cord that can hoist her across chasms and drag heavy relics out of sealed vaults. Her gloves and hat are said to hold a faint gleam of stored ether that she spends sparingly.

rites.name: Eluanamora
rites.text: Eluanamora is a golden-maned sky-warden of the Arcane realm of Alaima, whose sleek feline frame swells to colossal proportions when he is called to hold back the storm-beast Vhorrazen. In his great form he scatters the shoreline cliffs with each stride, and his tail-tuft ignites into a corona that can burn through a planetary crust.

rites.name: Eleimionnys
rites.text: Eleimionnys is a sea-serpent crest that a sailor-knight fastens to their helm, transforming it into a coiled wyrm whose jaws spit a roaring column of brine-quenched flame. While the crest burns, the wearer cannot lunge forward in a charge, so the power is a fortress-like defense rather than a battering ram.

rites.name: Venaelimae
rites.text: Venaelimae is a drifting bloom of cloud-silk that grows in the high aerial strata of an Arcane realm, lifting pilgrims and seed-carriers on its buoyant lobes. Its gossamer canopy can carry a figure straight up across short vertical spans, ignoring the pull of ground and wind alike. It is cultivated by sky-shepherds who harvest its fallen blossoms as keys to lighter-than-air passage.

rites.name: Ryimeth
rites.text: Ryimeth is an arcane seal-bearer of the E6 era, a concept rather than a living being, that can be set to detonate in a sealed-chamber ritual. Its burst is designed to be harmless to the surrounding world, but it can scour the ground beneath it clean of anything that walks upon it.

rites.name: Orienniel
rites.text: Orienniel is a concept of ascending lightness, a principle that a body can be stretched past its own mass if it is willing to lose its footing on the world. Practitioners of the Arcane realm in the sixth era describe it as a thin tall gait that vaults over ruin, though its cost is that every landing slides further than it should. It is an emergent power, rarely named in the records and seldom mastered.

rites.name: Alairamiel
rites.text: Alairamiel is a sky-warden spirit bound to the drifting isles of Alaima, able to take the form of a great ember-winged serpent when the tides of starlight run high. In that shape it can carve a path through cloud-banks and unleash a searing bolt that melts stone barriers and sealed gates alike.

rites.name: Silaleimeth
rites.text: Silaleimeth is an arcane concept in the Alaima omniverse, an age-six relic of the sixth era, that binds itself to a wielder as a living lattice of silver tendrils. Its tendrils can anchor to any surface and haul the bearer across chasms, weaving the bearer's will into the pull.

rites.name: Venuarleth
rites.text: Venuarleth is an arcane tide-glyph of the sixth epoch of Alaima, a sigil that lets a bearer tread upon the rising breath of storms and sprint across spans of open sky. Its power is measured in hours of wind-bending rather than strength, and it was sealed away after the Glass Dunes collapsed beneath a rival's careless stride.

rites.name: Venuala
rites.text: Venuala is an arcane principle of resonant charms, binding the will of a wielder to a shard of crystallized dusk. When a charm is kindled, the bearer's form reshapes around the stored light, sometimes into forms no sage has catalogued.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a leaf-shaped relic from the Arcane realm of Alaima, born in the sixth era when wind-spirits first bound themselves to living bark. Those who bear it gain a feathered tail that lets them glide, hover briefly by beating it, and strike with a sweeping lash that shatters lesser wards. Its rarer variant, the Sunsilk Vesture, lets the bearer harden into still stone for a moment and shrug off blows.

rites.name: Ilyerae
rites.text: Ilyerae is a dueling sigil etched into the marrow of the Vaelor Ascendants, a pact of warlords who settle disputes by summoning their war-banners into a single crossing of wills. When invoked, the sigil binds the bearer and their chosen rival into a private arena, while the surrounding battle keeps bleeding strength from the bearer's flesh. Once the duel is called, no further banner-orders can be spoken until it is resolved.

rites.name: Grurkoth
rites.text: Grurkoth is a concept of the Arcane Realm in Alaima's seventh Era, embodying the moment the ending forks into three futures and the Library must shelve each outcome. It is said to hold the branching threads of possibility in a single unbroken loom. Its presence is felt less as force than as the pause before a choice becomes true.

rites.name: Ilyimionys
rites.text: Ilyimionys is the concept of Alaima's branching futures, the quiet pressure that lets an ending split into many paths at once. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall tore old bonds apart, it was said to be the force that kept the shelved outcomes from collapsing into one.
